classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Decoy.

classes.label: Artifact Identifier
classes.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity which designates some Material Artifact.

classes.label: Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that classifies Entities according to some shared, possibly arbitrary, characteristic. Four of the subtypes of measurements used here (Interval, Nominal, Ordinal, and Ratio) were originally defined by S.S. Stevens in the article "On the Theory of Scales of Measurement" in Science, Vol. 103 No. 2684 on June 7, 1946. For an introductory article with links to additional content including criticisms and alternate classifications of measurements see
examples: The sentence "January 20, 1985 was a cold day in Chicago, IL" is the carrier of a nominal measurement.
a measurement that classifies automobiles as sedans, coupes, hatchbacks, or convertibles
a measurement that classifies military intelligence as strategic, operational, or tactical
a measurement that classifies rocks as igneous, sedimentary, or metamorphic

classes.label: Air-Breathing Jet Engine
classes.definition: A Jet Engine that is propelled by a jet of hot exhaust gases formed from air that is drawn into the Engine via an Air Inlet.

classes.label: Wetness
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which the bearer is covered by a liquid, typically on a continuum of dry to wet.

classes.label: Angular Velocity
classes.definition: A Velocity that is characterized by both the angular Speed of an object and the Axis about which the object is Rotating.

classes.label: Portion of Hydrosphere
classes.definition: A fiat object part of the combined mass of water found on, under, and above the surface of a natural satellite

classes.label: Shoulder-Fired Rocket Launcher
classes.definition: A Rocket Launcher that is designed to be small enough to be carried by a single person and fired while supported on the person's shoulder.

classes.label: Prosthetic Leg
classes.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing leg.

classes.label: Group of Agents
classes.definition: An Object Aggregate that has only Agents as member parts.

classes.label: Vehicle Transmission
classes.definition: A Power Transmission Artifact that is designed to vary the output speed and torque in a rotating power transfer system.

classes.label: Alternating Current Power Source
classes.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to transfer electrical power in the form of alternating current.

classes.label: Intercommunication System
classes.definition: A Communication System that is designed to enable some Act of Communication between end points within a building, small collection of buildings, or within a small area of service.

classes.label: Microscope
classes.definition: An Imaging Instrument that is designed to enable users to see Objects that are otherwise too small to be seen by the naked eye by producing a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

classes.label: Sound Pressure
classes.definition: A Pressure that is caused by a Sound Wave and is a local deviation from the ambient Pressure.

classes.label: Hinge
classes.definition: A Machine Bearing that is designed to limit the angle of Rotation between two solid objects.

classes.label: Portion of Food
classes.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that is designed to be consumed and ingested for nutrition or taste.

classes.label: Act of Military Service
classes.definition: An Act of Employment by an Organization wherein a Person serves as a member of a Military Force, whether voluntarily or by conscription.
parents: Act of Employment by an Organization

classes.label: Healthcare Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of treating and preventing illness.

classes.label: Grenade
classes.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be relatively small and to be thrown by hand.

classes.label: Filtration Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Filter Function that is realized in a process in which some solid entity is prevented from moving along with some quantity of liquid.

classes.label: Propulsion Process
classes.definition: A Natural Process in which one or more Forces are generated and applied to a participating Object such that the Object is set in Motion or has the direction or magnitude of its Motion altered. In each case, a Propulsion Process minimally involves the Object being propelled, a Reaction Mass (e.g. a portion of water, atmosphere, exhaust, etc.), and the Force(s) acting between these two entities.
examples: a twin-engine turboprop plane rotating both of its propellers against a portion of atmosphere to propel the plane forward
an apple falling to the ground under the power of Earth's gravitational force
burning a portion of fuel to produce exhaust that is ejected through a jet nozzle to propel a rocket and its payload
heat from a fire causing ashes to rise into the sky
launching a water balloon using a sling shot
the wind blowing leaves across a lawn
turning a paddle wheel against a portion of water to propel the paddle boat forward

classes.label: Wavelength
classes.definition: A Wave Process Profile that is the distance the Wave Process traverses during one Wave Cycle. Assuming a non-dispersive media, the Wavelength will be the inverse of the Frequency.

classes.label: Information Quality Entity
classes.definition: A Quality that concretizes some Information Content Entity. Typically, an IQE will be a complex pattern made up of multiple qualities joined together spatially.

classes.label: Telecommunication Switching Node
classes.definition: A Telecommunication Network Node that is capable of redirecting a communication transmission to another Telecommunication Network Node.

classes.label: Portion of Liquid Helium
classes.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid helium.

classes.label: Electronic Signal Processing Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Signal Processing Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to process or transfer information contained in electronic signals.

classes.label: Disease
classes.definition: A Disposition to undergo pathological processes that exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

classes.label: Artifact Design
classes.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that is a specification of an object, manifested by an agent, intended to accomplish goals, in a particular environment, using a set of primitive components, satisfying a set of requirements, subject to constraints.

classes.label: Act of Reconnaissance
classes.definition: An Act of Intelligence Gathering used to determine an Agent's disposition and intention; the composition and capabilities of Equipment and Facilities, and the surrounding landforms and weather conditions.

classes.label: Residential Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of residing in a dwelling or home.

classes.label: Act of Funding
classes.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use in which an Agent (the Funder) provides some Financial Instrument to another Agent (the recipient of the funds) as a resource pool that is earmarked by the Funder for a future transaction.

classes.label: Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Function that inheres in some Material Artifact in virtue of that Material Artifact being designed to be used in processes that require that Function to be realized.

classes.label: Width
classes.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a horizontal direction.

classes.label: Radio Transponder
classes.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that acts as both a Radio Transmitter and responder and is used to wirelessly receive and transmit electrical signals.

classes.label: Texture
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the size, shape, and distribution of features on its surface, typically on a continuum from smooth to rough.

classes.label: Transportation Infrastructure
classes.definition: An Infrastructure System that has continuant part one or more Transportation Artifacts and bears a function that, if realized, is realized in Acts of Cargo Transportation

classes.label: Multi-Month Temporal Interval
classes.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Months and spans at least one Month. This is a defined class.

classes.label: Thermal Power Plant
classes.definition: An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert heat energy into electrical energy.

classes.label: House
classes.definition: A Residential Facility that is designed to provide a self-standing, permanent residence for an individual, family, household, multiple families, or similar-sized group.

classes.label: Training Camp
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed for rigorous and focused training in order to learn or improve skills, usually involving physical actions.

classes.label: Gas Turbine
classes.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that has a rotating compressor and a turbine and is designed to operate utilizing continous Combustion to produce Thrust, either directly via exhaust or indirectly via a prop.

classes.label: Interphone
classes.definition: An Intercommunication System that that is designed to facilitate some Act of Communication between agents by means of audio messages.

classes.label: Stasis of Generically Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Stasis in which some Independent Continuant bears some Generically Dependent Continuant that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

classes.label: Apartment Building
classes.definition: A Residential Facility that is designed to contain multiple permanent residences comprised of a suite of rooms.

classes.label: Rocket-Propelled Grenade
classes.definition: An Unguided Rocket that is designed to contain an explosive warhead, be fired from a Shoulder-Fired Rocket Launcher, and be used against Tanks.

classes.label: Fan
classes.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of a rotating arrangement of vanes or blades that are designed to act on a portion of fluid to create flow within it.

classes.label: Agricultural Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed as a building or campus for agricultural processes with the aim of cultivating animals, plants, or fungi for food, fiber, biofuel, medicinal plants, or other products to sustain and enhance human life.

classes.label: Mortar
classes.definition: A Cannon that is designed to fire projectiles at relatively low velocities over relatively short ranges.

classes.label: Prosthetic Arm
classes.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing arm.

classes.label: Brake
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to inhibit the Vehicle's Motion by absorbing energy from a moving system.

classes.label: Reciprocating Steam Engine
classes.definition: A Steam Engine that is designed to use one or more reciprocating pistons to convert pressure into a rotating motion.

classes.label: Surfactant Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Emulsifier Artifact Function that is realized in a process that lowers the surface tension between two liquids or between a liquid and a solid.

classes.label: Act of Measuring
classes.definition: A Planned Act that involves determining the extent, dimensions, quanity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard.
examples: putting an object on a scale to measure its weight in kilograms
rating Hollywood movies on a 1 to 5 star scale
using a tape measure to determine the height and width of a doorway in inches

classes.label: Communication Instrument
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate communication between at least two entities.

classes.label: Electronic Bond
classes.definition: A Bond that consists of Bytes.

classes.label: Filter
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that bears a Filter Function.

classes.label: Police Station
classes.definition: A Public Safety Facility that is designed for the professional and clerical processes of a local police force.

classes.label: Cooling System
classes.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to cool the air or objects in a Site.

classes.label: Act of Commanding
classes.definition: An Act of Directive Communication through which an Agent exercises authoritative control or power over another Agent's actions.

classes.label: Satellite Artifact
classes.definition: A Spacecraft that is designed to Orbit a Space Object (typically Earth).

classes.label: Research Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to perform research on a specified entity or class of entities.

classes.label: Act of Testifying
classes.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by stating one's personal knowledge or belief.

classes.label: Refracting Optical Telescope
classes.definition: An Optical Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light via refraction through the use of one or more Lenses to form an enhanced image of the Object.

classes.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Article
classes.definition: An Act of Publishing a non-fictional essay, especially one included with others in a newspaper, magazine, journal, etc.

classes.label: Act of Motion
classes.definition: A Planned Act by which an Agent causes the position or location of some Object to change.

classes.label: Geospatial Region Bounding Box
classes.definition: A Geospatial Polygon that is a boundary of some Geospatial Region that has another Geospatial Region as a non-tangential proper part.

classes.label: Julian Date
classes.definition: A Time of Day as specified according to the Julian Calendar using the Julian Date epoch.

classes.label: Wounded Stasis
classes.definition: A Damaged Stasis in which a Person or other organism is the bearer of a Quality or Realizable Entity that has suffered impairment (i.e., a decrease or loss) due to an injuring event.

classes.label: Increase of Function
classes.definition: An Increase of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Function that it bears.

classes.label: Rocket Engine
classes.definition: A Jet Engine that is designed to use only stored Rocket Propellant to form a high speed propulsive jet in order to generate Thrust. Most rocket engines are also Internal Combustion Engines, however non-combusting forms also exist. For example, an untied balloon full of air that is released and allowed to zoom around the room may be both a Rocket Engine and a Physically Powered Engine.

classes.label: Wireless Telecommunication Network
classes.definition: A Telecommunication Network that uses wireless connections to connect Telecommunication Network Nodes.

classes.label: Pneumatic Motor
classes.definition: A Physically Powered Engine that converts potential energy stored in a portion of compressed air into mechanical energy.

classes.label: x-Axis
classes.definition: A Coordinate System Axis designated by the variable 'x'.

classes.label: Act of Information Processing
classes.definition: A Planned Act in which one or more input Information Content Entities are received, manipulated, transferred, or stored by an Agent.

classes.label: Act of Military Training Instruction
classes.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Military Organization by imparting knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of Military Operations to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

classes.label: Rotational Motion
classes.definition: A Motion Process in which an Object moves in a Circular or Elliptical Path around an Axis of Rotation.

classes.label: Priority Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the relative importance of an entity.
examples: low, normal, high, urgent, or immediate priority

classes.label: Act of Condoling
classes.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing sympathy or sorrow.

classes.label: Act of Prediction
classes.definition: A Planned Act that involves the generation of a Predictive Information Content entity that is intended to describe an uncertain possible future event, value, entity, or attribute of an entity. An Act of Prediction may involve the use of some or no relevant information. An Act of Prediction that utilizes relevant information may also be (or at least involve) an Act of Estimation. Hence, these two classes are not disjoint. Furthermore, neither class subsumes the other since estimates can be made about existing entities and not all predictions produce measurements (e.g. predicting that it will rain tomorrow).
examples: a chess master predicting the next 8 moves his opponent will make
predicting that a particular stock will double in value over the next fiscal quarter
using sample exit polls data to predict the winners of an election

classes.label: Power Transformer Rectifier Unit
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to perform the functions of both a Rectifier and a Transformer.

classes.label: Geospatial Position
classes.definition: A Fiat Point that is at or near the surface of the Earth and fixed according to some Geospatial Coordinate Reference System.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Volumetric Flow Rate
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit of Flow that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate at which volumes of fluid pass per unit time.
examples: cubic metres per second, standard cubic centimeters per minute, cubic feet per second, gallons per minute

classes.label: Warehouse
classes.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store commercial goods.

classes.label: Portion of Gallium Arsenide
classes.definition: A Portion of Material that is composed of a compound of the elements gallium and arsenic.

classes.label: Disability
classes.definition: A Quality inhering in an Agent by virtue a physical or mental condition that limits the Agent's movements, senses, or activities.

classes.label: Color
classes.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's Color Hue, Color Saturation and Color Brightness.

classes.label: Act of Representative Communication
classes.definition: An Act of Communication that commits a speaker to the truth of the expressed content. Examples: affirming, alleging, announcing, answering, attributing, claiming, classifying, concurring, confirming, conjecturing, denying, disagreeing, disclosing, disputing, identifying, informing, insisting, predicting, ranking, reporting, stating, stipulating

classes.label: Pressure
classes.definition: A Force that is applied perpendicular to the surface of an Object per unit area over which that Force is distributed.

classes.label: Weapon Manufacturing Facility
classes.definition: A Factory that is designed to produce or assemble weapons.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Spreadsheet
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some Information Content Entity in an interactive, tabular form.

classes.label: Nuclear Family
classes.definition: A Family composed of parents and their children.

classes.label: Rectilinear Motion
classes.definition: A Translational Motion process in which an Object moves along a straight path.

classes.label: Wide
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly larger in proportion to its length or height.

classes.label: Webcast
classes.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience occurs over the Internet using streaming media technology to distribute a single content source that may be distributed live or on demand. Essentially, webcasting is “broadcasting” over the Internet.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

classes.label: Axis of Rotation
classes.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region defined by the line around which a spinning body rotates.

classes.label: Citizen
classes.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Citizen Role.

classes.label: Act of Buying
classes.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Buyer) to acquire ownership of a good from another Agent (the Seller).

classes.label: Spatial Region Identifier
classes.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Spatial Region.

classes.label: Tremendously High Frequency
classes.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 300 GHz and 3 THz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 1–0.1 mm

classes.label: Allegiance Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of the support it has committed to provide to another Agent when that Agent is involved in a conflict.

classes.label: Yaw Axis
classes.definition: An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass from the top to the bottom and is perpendicular to the direction of the object's motion. For objects in Orbit, the Yaw Axis passes through the Barycenter of its Orbit.

classes.label: Internal Combustion Engine
classes.definition: A Combustion Engine that is designed to have an internal Combustion Chamber where portions of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture are burned to generate thermal energy that is then converted into mechanical energy.

classes.label: Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Gain of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Specifically Dependent Continuant.
examples: A Person becomes pregnant (gain of quality), A person becomes forgetful (gain of disposition), A vehicle becomes amphibious (gain of function), A Person becomes a Database Administrator (gain of role).

classes.label: Extremely Low Frequency
classes.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 Hz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 100,000–10,000 km

classes.label: Combustion Chamber
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to wholly or partially bound an internal Site where a Combustion process is intended to occur.

classes.label: Reference System
classes.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes a set of standards for organizing and understanding data of the specified type or domain.

classes.label: Temporal Region Identifier
classes.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Temporal Region.

classes.label: Park
classes.definition: An Anthropogenic Feature that is a bounded area of land, or water, usually in its natural or semi-natural (landscaped) state and set aside for some purpose, usually to do with recreation or conservation.

classes.label: Fundamental Frequency
classes.definition: A Sound Frequency that is the lowest Frequency of a Sound Wave.

classes.label: Act of Communication
classes.definition: A Planned Act in which the objective is to create a concretization of some Information Content Entity in one or more recipients. Act of Communication is not intended to be a success term - a term that only applies when the act it denotes is successful. While successful communication is the goal, it is important that instances of this class can include both better and worse communication acts as well attempted communications that fail altogether.

classes.label: Diffraction Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a diffraction event in which the Material Artifact forces a wave to bend around the corners of an obstacle or aperture into the region of geometrical shadow of the obstacle.

classes.label: Iris
classes.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of the part of an Eye that is a pigmented, round, contractile membrane, suspended between the cornea and lens and perforated by the pupil, and which canonically regulates the amount of light entering the Eye.

classes.label: Second-Order Administrative Region
classes.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a First-Order Administrative Region.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Geocoordinate
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit specifying the geospatial coordinates of a location.

classes.label: Electrical Resistance Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which a Material Artifact opposes the flow of an electric current.

classes.label: Government Organization
classes.definition: An Organization that is part of a Government and is responsible for the oversight or administration of specific governmental functions.

classes.label: Spark Ignition System
classes.definition: An Ignition System that is designed to produce a spark in order to initiate an Ignition process.

classes.label: Residential Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to house one or more Persons.

classes.label: Speed Measurement Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Speed of a specified object's or class of objects' Motion.

classes.label: Oxidizer Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which electrons are removed from a reactant in a redox reaction.

classes.label: Electron Microscope
classes.definition: A Microscope that is designed to use a beam of accelerated electrons to illuminate the target and produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

classes.label: Square Waveform
classes.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a square shape due to the near-instantaneous transitions between minimum and maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

classes.label: Anti-Microbial Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a microorganism.

classes.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Press Release
classes.definition: An Act of Publishing an official statement to one or more members of the media for the purpose of announcing newsworthy information.

classes.label: Prosthetic Hand
classes.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing hand.

classes.label: Biographical Life
classes.definition: An Act composed of the Life Events that occur during the course of existence of an Agent (i.e. Person or Organization).

classes.label: Part Number
classes.definition: A Code Identifier that designates a type of part whose instances are designed to be part of some Material Artifact.

classes.label: Computer
classes.definition: An Information Processing Artifact that is designed to execute an arbitrary set of arithmetic or logical operations automatically.

classes.label: Nuclear Power Plant
classes.definition: A Thermal Power Plant that is designed to produce heat by means of a nuclear reactor, which is then converted to electrical energy.

classes.label: Communication Reception Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process of receiving information.

classes.label: Motor Vehicle Manufacturing Facility
classes.definition: A Factory that is designed to manufacture automobiles.

classes.label: Sharp
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a fine point or thin edge.

classes.label: Gregorian Year
classes.definition: A Calendar Year in the Gregorian Calendar. A Gregorian Year begins concurrently with January 1, ends concurrently with December 31, and has an average duration of exactly 365.2425 Gregorian Days. The Gregorian Year is based upon the vernal equinox year. Unless otherwise stated, instances of Calendar Year are assumed to be instances of Gregorian Year since the Gregorian Calendar is the most widely used civil Calendar System.

classes.label: Military Personnel Force
classes.definition: An Armed Force authorized to use deadly force, and weapons, to support the interests of the Government and some or all of its Citizens.

classes.label: Armored Fighting Vehicle
classes.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to be armored and used to transport and support military personal in combat missions.

classes.label: Railway Junction
classes.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable a Train to switch between the tracks of two routes.

classes.label: Stable Orientation
classes.definition: A Stasis of Quality that holds during a Temporal Interval when an object maintains the same Spatial Orientation.

classes.label: External Combustion Engine
classes.definition: A Combustion Engine that is designed to have an external Combustion Chamber where portions of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture are burned to generate thermal energy to heat the working fluid, which transfers energy to the Engine where it is converted into mechanical energy.

classes.label: Missile Launch Site
classes.definition: A Military Facility that is designed for storing and launching missiles.

classes.label: Act of Association
classes.definition: A Social Act wherein an Agent unites with some other Agent in a Planned Act, enterprise or business.

classes.label: Simple Optical Lens
classes.definition: An Optical Lens consisting of a single piece of transparent material.

classes.label: Gregorian Day
classes.definition: A Calendar Day in the Gregorian Calendar. A Gregorian Day is twenty-four Hours in duration.

classes.label: X-ray Microscope
classes.definition: A Microscope that is designed to use Electromagnetic Radiation in the soft X-ray band to produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

classes.label: Enhancing Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of intensifying, increainsg, or further improving the quality, value, or extent of some entity.

classes.label: Act of Official Documentation
classes.definition: An Act of Declarative Communication in which an Agent records some information for official use by another Agent.

classes.label: Black
classes.definition: A Color that lacks any hues as parts.

classes.label: Watercraft
classes.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by water travel.

classes.label: Temperature
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its thermal energy.

classes.label: Radioactive
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer exhibiting or being caused by radioactivity.

classes.label: Commercial Organization
classes.definition: An Organization that is the bearer of a Commercial Role and whose primary objective is to make a profit from the provision of goods or services.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Energy
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the Amount of work that is available in an object.
examples: ft-lbs, calorie, horsepower, kilowatt

classes.label: Weapon
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to destroy or inflict damage to structures or systems, or to kill or wound living things by creating specific lethal or nonlethal effects. Nonlethal effects include all outcomes short of death or destruction. This is captured by the fact that Damaged Stasis and Wounded Stasis are defined in terms of impairment of the Independent Continuant that participates in them.

classes.label: Circumference
classes.definition: A Perimeter that inheres in a circle or ellipse.

classes.label: Triangular
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having exactly three angles and exactly three sides.

classes.label: Motion Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an entity changes its position with respect to time.

classes.label: Act of Remuneration
classes.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Employer) to compensate another Agent (the Employee) for the services they perform for the Employer. Comment: Remuneration normally consists of salary or hourly wages, but also applies to commission, stock options, fringe benefits, etc.

classes.label: Silver Color
classes.definition: A Color that resembles Grey with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

classes.label: Collimation Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a collimation event in which the Material Artifact narrows a beam of particles or waves by either causing the spatial cross-section of the beam to become smaller or by causing the directions of motion of the beam's constituents to be aligned in a specifc direction of Motion.

classes.label: Timekeeping Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to keep track of and report the current time.

classes.label: Environment Control System
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to control the temperature, air quality, or other feature of a Site that is relevant to the comfort or operation of entities located within that Site. Controlling air quality typically involves temperature control, oxygen replenishment, and removal of moisture, odor, smoke, heat, dust, airborne bacteria, carbon dioxide, and other undesired gases or particulates.

classes.label: Compression Ignition System
classes.definition: An Ignition System that is designed to generate heat by compressing a portion of fuel and oxidizer mixture in order to initiate an Ignition process.

classes.label: Act of Ceremony
classes.definition: A Social Act of ritual significance, performed on a special occasion.

classes.label: Railway
classes.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Trains to transport passengers and goods.

classes.label: Portion of Material
classes.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that was produced to be used as the input for another Act of Material Artifact Processing.

classes.label: Coupling
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to connect two Shafts together at their ends for the purpose of transmitting power.

classes.label: Fluorescence
classes.definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light while absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, but not after.

classes.label: Local Administrative Region
classes.definition: A Government Domain that delimits a local Government.

classes.label: Gain of Function
classes.definition: A Gain of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Function. This class should be used to demarcate the start of the temporal interval (through the BFO 'occupies temporal region' property) that the Entity bears the Function.

classes.label: Act of Educational Training Instruction
classes.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Educational Organization by imparting knowledge of a curriculum to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

classes.label: Oblong
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an long thin shape with approximately parallel sides.

classes.label: Modified Julian Date
classes.definition: A Time of Day as specified according to the Julian Calendar using the Modified Julian Date epoch. A Day begins at midnight GMT within the Modified Julian Date reference system. The Modified Julian Date (MJD) is related to the Julian Date (JD) by the formula: MJD = JD - 2400000.5

classes.label: Orientation Control Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the Orientation of some object.

classes.label: Armored Personnel Carrier
classes.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to transport infantry to the battlefield but which are not usually designed to take part in a direct-fire battle.

classes.label: Office Building
classes.definition: A Commercial Facility that is designed as an environment for conducting commercial, professional, or bureaucratic work.

classes.label: Geospatial Coordinate Reference System
classes.definition: A Spatial Reference System that is used to determine and identify the location of a point or object at or near the surface of the Earth.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Academic Degree
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Certificate that is issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Warning Message
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Notification Message that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that describes a possible or impending threat.
parents: Material Copy of a Notification Message

classes.label: Geospatial Region
classes.definition: A Site that is at or near the surface of the Earth.

classes.label: Fourth-Order Administrative Region
classes.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Third-Order Administrative Region.

classes.label: Curved
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having borders which are smoothly rounded.

classes.label: Portion of Cash
classes.definition: A Financial Instrument that is designed to be a ready medium of exchange.

classes.label: Objective
classes.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some projected state that some Agent intends to achieve.

classes.label: Fuel Cell
classes.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of an anode, a cathode, and an electrolyte; converts chemical energy from a fuel into electricity through a chemical reaction of positively charged hydrogen ions with an oxidizing agent (typically oxygen); and, if given a continuous source of fuel and oxidizing agent, can continuously produce electricity. A Fuel Cell differs from a Battery in that it requires a continuous source of fuel and oxygen to sustain the chemical reaction, whereas a Battery only uses chemicals already stored inside it.

classes.label: Cuboidal
classes.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having six Rectangular faces.

classes.label: Public Safety Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed for the prevention of and protection from events that could endanger, injure, or damage the general public.

classes.label: Life Support Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact materially affects an organism, where this causes that organism to continue living in a situation where death would otherwise occur.

classes.label: Research and Development Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of producing new knowledge or of devising new applications of existing knowledge.

classes.label: Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Radar Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce visual representations of entities using the motion of a radar antenna over a targeted region to create a synthetic aperture.

classes.label: Military Base
classes.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to shelter military equipment and personnel and to facilitate training and operations.

classes.label: Concave Shape
classes.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more cavities, such that at least one line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

classes.label: Commercial Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an Organization by virtue of its establishment as a for-profit business.

classes.label: Neutral Role
classes.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent not performing or being committed to performing Acts that have as their Objective to either support or undermine the Objectives of an Agent or Group of Agents involved in some conflict.

classes.label: Geospatial Location
classes.definition: A Geospatial Region that is the location of an Independent Continuant (that is not a Spatial Region) or that environs some Process.

classes.label: Tripod
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that consists of three legs and a platform that joins them and which is designed to support the weight and maintain the stability of objects that are attached to or rested on the platform.

classes.label: High Density Residential Area
classes.definition: A Populated Place which is characterized by densely contained multiple-unit living structures.

classes.label: X-ray Frequency
classes.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 30 petahertz and 30 exahertz.

classes.label: Detonating Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of combustion involving a supersonic exothermic front accelerating through a medium that eventually drives a shock front propagating directly in front of it.

classes.label: Email Messaging
classes.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which digital messages are transmitted and received via Internet Message Format-based communication, or an extension thereof, over a computer network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

classes.label: Material Copy of a Code List
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a List that contains an ordered sequence of Information Bearing Entities that carry Code Identifiers.

classes.label: Serrated
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having multiple sharp points along a edge.

classes.label: Radio Communication Interference Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Communication Interference Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to interfere with the transmission of information via radio waves.

classes.label: Natural Language
classes.definition: A Language that is developed and evolves through use and repetition, rather than through conscious planning or premeditation.
examples: English
Mandarin (Chinese)
Spanish

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Force
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of interactions in which the Motion or Velocity of an object is changed, unless the interaction is opposed.
examples: newton, dyne, pound force

classes.label: Julian Day
classes.definition: A Calendar Day in the Julian Calendar. A Julian Day begins at noon Universal Time and is twenty-four Hours in duration.

classes.label: Wire Antenna
classes.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists primarily of a length of wire.

classes.label: Eye
classes.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of an organ that canonically affords the Agent it is part of with the ability to receive visual stimuli necessary for sight.

classes.label: Act of Financial Withdrawal
classes.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent to another Agent (the Depositor) from an account created by an earlier Act of Financial Deposit performed by the Depositor.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Area Moment of Inertia
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the distribution of Mass of an object with respect to an axis. A measure of an object’s resistance to bending or deflection.
altLabels: Measurement Unit of Second Area Moment

classes.label: Power
classes.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the rate of Work, or Energy consumed, done in a given time period.

classes.label: Optical Processing Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a visible light processing event.

classes.label: Contractor Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents entering into a Contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or complete a task. A Contractor Role differs from an Occupation Role in at least two ways. First, the Contract that binds the two parties together is not one of employment. Second, a Contractor Role is occupationally neutral in that an Agent can be contracted to perform any number of Occupational Roles.

classes.label: Ethnic Group
classes.definition: A Group of Persons who identify with one another based on one or more shared inherited characteristics such as language, ancestry, nationality, culture, customs, religion, or social experiences.

classes.label: Near Ultraviolet Light Frequency
classes.definition: An Ultraviolet Light Frequency that is between 750 terahertz and 3 petahertz.

classes.label: Service Provider
classes.definition: An Organization whose purpose is to provide a service to other Agents.

classes.label: Mosque
classes.definition: A Religious Facility that is designed for Islamic worship and prayer.

classes.label: Act of Planning
classes.definition: A Planned Act that involves making a Plan to achieve some specified Objective.

classes.label: Radiation Emissivity
classes.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to emit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

classes.label: Act of Tool Use
classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Tool.

classes.label: Transverse Wave Profile
classes.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the displacement of participating particles is perpendicular to the direction of the Wave Process' propogation.

classes.label: Act of Vehicle Use
classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Vehicle.

classes.label: Pneumatic Power Source
classes.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, or transmit power by means of compressed air or compressed inert gases.

classes.label: Act of Communication by Movement of Information Bearing Artifact
classes.definition: An Act of Communication in which some Material Artifact is used to transfer an Information Bearing Entity from sender(s) to receiver(s). An Act of Communication by Movement of Information Bearing Artifact is distinguished by the fact that the Information Content Entity is transferred in virtue of its Information Bearing Artifact being transferred; as opposed to a new copy of the Information Content Entity being created in another bearer. Additional examples include passing notes in class, going door-to-door distributing pamphlets, lending/borrowing your physical copy of a book, etc.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Currency
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit used in measurements of financial values.
examples: U.S. Dollar, Euro, Yuan, South African Rand

classes.label: Extremely High Frequency
classes.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 30 and 300 GHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 10–1 mm

classes.label: Act of Departure
classes.definition: An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity leaving its starting location such that the larger Act of Location Change is initiated.

classes.label: Act of Assassination
classes.definition: An Act of Murder of a prominent person.

classes.label: Pulsejet Engine
classes.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that is capable of operating statically and uses intermittent (pulsing) Combustion of the fuel-oxidizer mixture before expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

classes.label: Loudness
classes.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the amplitude and total energy of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from soft to loud.

classes.label: Air Conditioning Unit
classes.definition: A Cooling System that is designed to remove excess heat and humidity from the air in an enclosed space.

classes.label: Transparent
classes.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit all or nearly all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs little or no electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

classes.label: Gamma-ray Telescope
classes.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing Gamma-rays to form an enhanced image of the Object.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Rotational Inertia
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the distribution of Mass of an object with respect to its axis of rotation. A measure of an object’s resistance to change in its state of rotation.
altLabels: Measurement Unit of Moment of Inertia

classes.label: White
classes.definition: A Color of maximum brightness, the color of objects that reflect nearly all wavelengths of the visible light spectrum, thus considered achromatic.

classes.label: Date Identifier
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval Identifier that designates some Day.

classes.label: Sonic Frequency
classes.definition: A Sound Frequency that is between 20 Hz and 20 kHz. Sound waves with frequencies in this range are typically audible to humans.

classes.label: Communications Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to support processes of receiving or transmitting information.

classes.label: Government of a Country
classes.definition: A Government that has legitimate authority within and is delimited by a Domain of a Country.

classes.label: Jet Engine
classes.definition: A Reaction Engine that discharges a fast moving jet that generates Thrust by jet propulsion. Some (most) jet engines utilize turbines, but some do not. Most rocket engines do not utilize turbines, but some do.

classes.label: Cutting Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired by being opened or divided.

classes.label: Decrease of Quality
classes.definition: A Decrease of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Quality that it bears.
examples: Weight Loss, Decreasing Temperature, decreasing color intensity, loss of structural integrity

classes.label: Bond Certificate
classes.definition: A Bond that consists of a Certificate.

classes.label: Financial Instrument
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be a tradeable asset and that is legally sanctioned.

classes.label: Defoliant Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Herbicide Artifact Function that is realized in a process that causes a plant to lose its leaves.

classes.label: Count Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the number of members of some aggregate.

classes.label: Temporal Instant Identifier
classes.definition: A Temporal Region Identifier that designates some Temporal Instant.

classes.label: Diameter
classes.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a circle in virtue of the extent of a straight line that passes through the center of the circle and starts and ends on the circle's boundary.

classes.label: Loss of Generically Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Loss of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the carrier of some Generically Dependent Continuant.

classes.label: Decrease of Disposition
classes.definition: A Decrease of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Disposition it bears.

classes.label: Target
classes.definition: A Material Entity that is the object of an Act of Targeting. Although people speak of targeting a process, say, a parade, what in fact are being targeted are the material participants of that process. The disruption or ceasing of the process is the objective of some plan, but not technically a target. Only material things can be targeted for action. Even if some dependent entity is described as being the target, the material thing for which that dependent entity depends is the object of a targeting process.

classes.label: Seat of Local Government
classes.definition: A Government Building that is designed for the administration of a local community.

classes.label: Unplanned Act
classes.definition: An Act in which at least one Agent plays a causative role and which is not prescribed by some Objective held by any of the Agents.

classes.label: Telescope
classes.definition: An Imaging Instrument that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing Electromagnetic Radiation to form an enhanced image of the Object.

classes.label: Vulnerability
classes.definition: A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in.

classes.label: Water Transportation Artifact
classes.definition: A Transportation Artifact that facilitates the movement of Agents and Vehicles via water.

classes.label: Morning
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when the sun dawns (approximately 6:00am) and reaches its apex (approximately 12:00pm).

classes.label: Organism
classes.definition: An Object that is an Animal or Plant.

classes.label: Explosive Weapon
classes.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of a violent release of energy caused by the exothermic reaction of an explosive material.

classes.label: Process Prohibition
classes.definition: A Process Regulation that prohibits some Process.

classes.label: Gain of Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Change in which an Independent Continuant becomes the bearer or carrier of some Dependent Continuant.

classes.label: Enhanced Stasis
classes.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has undergone improvement (i.e., an increase or gain) due to a previous action or event such that the Independent Continuant is now of greater value, usefulness, or functionality.

classes.label: Payload
classes.definition: A Material Entity that is transported by a Vehicle during an Act of Location Change for the purpose of being delivered to or performing one or more functions at a predefined location. Depending on the nature of the Flight or Mission, the Payload of a Vehicle may include cargo, passengers, flight crew, munitions, scientific instruments or experiments, or other equipment. Extra fuel, when optionally carried, is also considered part of the payload.

classes.label: Stasis of Non-Mission Capable
classes.definition: A Stasis of Mission Capability during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing any of its primary functions for the specified Mission.

classes.label: Visible Light Reflection Process
classes.definition: A Wave Process in which an Electromagnetic Wave with a Visible Light Frequency is reflected off a portion of matter.

classes.label: Cone Shape
classes.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having a Round base that tapers smoothly to an apex.

classes.label: Dam
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to impound surface water or underground streams.

classes.label: Animal
classes.definition: An Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, heterotrophic, and capable of motility for part of its life.

classes.label: Hydrographic Feature
classes.definition: A Geographic Feature associated with water.

classes.label: Educational Organization
classes.definition: An Organization whose primary purpose is to provide training or otherwise facilitate learning or the acquisition of knowledge, Skills, values, beliefs, or habits.

classes.label: Cube Shape
classes.definition: A Cuboidal shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having six Square faces.

classes.label: Act of Artifact Employment
classes.definition: A Planned Act of using a Material Artifact.

classes.label: Operational Area
classes.definition: A Geospatial Location in which an Agent conducts some activity. This is a general term that applies to both military and civilian activities, such as the Geospatial Region within which a company conducts its business.

classes.label: Organization Capability
classes.definition: An Agent Capability that inheres in an Organization to the extent of that Organization's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.

classes.label: Sensor
classes.definition: A Material Entity that bears a Sensor Function or Sensor Role.

classes.label: Force
classes.definition: A Process Profile that is the rate of change of an object's Momentum, is the product of an object's Mass and Acceleration with respect to an inertial frame of reference, and is measured in units of Newtons (N).

classes.label: Article of Solid Waste
classes.definition: A Portion of Waste Material that has a low liquid content.

classes.label: Sound Production
classes.definition: A Wave Production Process that produces a Sound Wave.

classes.label: Act of Religious Training Acquisition
classes.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tenets and/or practices of a religion from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Religious Organization.

classes.label: Environmental Feature
classes.definition: A Material Entity that is either a natural or man-made feature of the environment.

classes.label: Quality Specification
classes.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some Quality.

classes.label: Scalp
classes.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of the skin covering the top of the head of a human or other animal.

classes.label: Power Rectifier
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).

classes.label: Sloped
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border which is not level.

classes.label: Thin
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly smaller in proportion to its length or height.

classes.label: Sine Waveform
classes.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a smooth curved shape due to the continuous non-linear transitions between minimum and maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

classes.label: Tool
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to assist in the performance of manual or mechanical work and not to be consumed in that process.

classes.label: Motel
classes.definition: A Hotel that is designed to accommodate motor vehicles along with their occupants.

classes.label: Act of Position Change
classes.definition: An Act of Motion in which the position (i.e. the orientation, alignment, or arrangement) of some Object or of one or more of an Object's parts is changed by some Agent. An Act of Position Change does not entail a change of location.
examples: a top spinning in place
adjusting your posture
raising your left arm
swivelling your office chair to face the window

classes.label: Sawtooth Waveform
classes.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a sawtooth shape due to the continuous linear transition from minimum to maximum Amplitudes followed by a near-instantaneous transition from the maximum to minimum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

classes.label: Controllable Pitch Propeller
classes.definition: A Propeller whose blades are designed to be alterable by rotating the blades about their vertical axis by means of mechanical or hydraulic arrangement.

classes.label: Ally Role
classes.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of that Agent's commitment to perform Acts that support the Objectives of a particular Agent or Group of Agents.

classes.label: Act of Mass Media Communication
classes.definition: An Act of Communication intended to reach a large audience using a medium such as the internet, television, radio, newspaper, or magazine.

classes.label: Julian Date Fraction
classes.definition: A Decimal Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Julian Day.

classes.label: Convex Shape
classes.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having a cavity, such that no line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

classes.label: Artifact Location
classes.definition: A Site that is the location of some Material Artifact.

classes.label: Veracity Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which a description conforms to the reality it describes. 'Deviation Measurement Information Content Entity' and 'Veracity Measurement Information Content Entity' are complementary notions. Deviation is a measure of whether reality conforms to an ICE (e.g., a plan or prediction), whereas Veracity is a measure of whether a Descriptive ICE conforms to reality.

classes.label: Portion of Propellant
classes.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to be used as an input in a Propulsion Process to produce Thrust.

classes.label: Ignition Process
classes.definition: A Natural Process that initiates a Combustion process.

classes.label: Act of Cargo Transportation
classes.definition: An Act of Location Change wherein some Payload is moved from one location to another.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Instrument Display Panel
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry information about some Material Artifact that is derived by the instrumentation Sensors of that Material Artifact.

classes.label: Valve
classes.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to regulate, direct, or control the flow of fluid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing the fluid from moving along a passageway.

classes.label: Interpersonal Relationship Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in a Person in virtue of the obligations, expectations, or social norms that govern that Person's Intentional Acts within the context of a relationship with another Person.

classes.label: Legal Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of giving legal advice to clients drafting legal documents for clients and representing clients in legal negotiations and court proceedings such as lawsuits.

classes.label: Imaging Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to create one or more new Images.

classes.label: Navigation Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to determine the precise location of itself or another object and plan a route to a specified destination.

classes.label: Maximum Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of some entity in virtue of it being the largest or having the greatest amount relative to a nominally described set of like entities.

classes.label: Abbreviated Name
classes.definition: A Designative Name that is a shortened form of a Proper Name.

classes.label: Truck
classes.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to be used to transport cargo. Trucks vary greatly in their size and power -- ranging from small ultra-light trucks to enormous heavy trucks. Trucks also vary greatly in their configurations -- ranging from very basic flatbeds or box trucks to highly specialized cargo carriers. Trucks may also be configured to mount specialized equipment, such as in the case of fire trucks, concrete mixers, and suction excavators.

classes.label: Thickness
classes.definition: A Depth that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it extending inward through an object.

classes.label: Financial Value
classes.definition: A quality that inheres in an independent continuant to the degree that that independent continuant can serve as a medium of exchange in an economic system at a particular time.

classes.label: Gain of Disposition
classes.definition: A Gain of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Disposition. This class should be used to demarcate the start of the temporal interval (through the BFO 'occupies temporal region' property) that the Entity bears the Disposition.

classes.label: Ultraviolet Light Frequency
classes.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 750 terahertz and 30 petahertz.

classes.label: Increase of Realizable Entity
classes.definition: An Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Realizable Entity that it bears.

classes.label: Act of Weapon Use
classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Weapon.

classes.label: Loss of Role
classes.definition: A Loss of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Role.

classes.label: Mass
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the amount of matter in that bearer. 'Matter' here can also refer to the inertial energy of an object.

classes.label: Act of Encounter
classes.definition: An Act of Association wherein two or more Persons meet in a casual or unplanned manner.

classes.label: Religion
classes.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about the meaning or origin of existence or about the existence or nature of one or more deities, an afterlife, or spiritual or sacred entities, and which is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents.

classes.label: Infrared Camera
classes.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and record an image generated from infrared radiation.

classes.label: Ground Vehicle
classes.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by some form of ground travel.

classes.label: Week
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to seven consecutive Days.

classes.label: Radiopacity
classes.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to allow or prevent X-rays to pass through it.

classes.label: Inverse Sawtooth Waveform
classes.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a sawtooth shape due to the continuous linear transition from maximum to minimum Amplitudes followed by a near-instantaneous transition from the minimum to maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

classes.label: Stasis of Fully Mission Capable
classes.definition: A Stasis of Mission Capability during which the participating Continuant is capable of performing all of its primary functions for the specified Mission.

classes.label: Impact Shielding Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact reduces the damage caused to the shielded object by an impact with another object.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Report
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that conveys an account of some event, situation, or the result of some observation or inquiry.

classes.label: Nozzle Throat
classes.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of the narrowest portion of a Nozzle that is designed to converge the flow of fluid in order to increase the Velocity of the flow.

classes.label: Predictive Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes an uncertain future event. Since predictions are inherently about not-yet-existant things, the Modal Relation Ontology term 'describes' (i.e. mro:describes) should be used (instead of the standard cco:describes) to relate instances of Predictive Information Content Entity to the entities they are about.

classes.label: Infrastructure Element
classes.definition: A Material Entity that bears an Infrastructure Role.

classes.label: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation
classes.definition: A Disposition that inheres in a bearer in virtue of how that bearer interacts with electromagnetic radiation.

classes.label: Deception Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes which misinform or mislead some other entity.

classes.label: Universal Time Reference System
classes.definition: A Solar Time Reference System that is based on the average speed of the Earth's rotation and which uses the prime meridian at 0° longitude as a reference point.

classes.label: Material Territory of a Country
classes.definition: The portions of lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a The Domain of a Country.
parents: Material Territory of a Government Domain

classes.label: Magnetism
classes.definition: A Disposition that is realized when its bearer exerts a magnetic force on another entity.

classes.label: Weight
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in some material entity with a mass in virtue of its location in some gravitational field. When an object is "weighed", in the typical case, it is done so by taking into account the local force of gravity to determine the object's mass, whose standard of measure is the kilogram. The actual unit of measure of weight is the newton.

classes.label: Steam Engine
classes.definition: An External Combustion Engine that is designed to use steam as its working fluid.

classes.label: Refraction Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a refraction event in which the Material Artifact causes a change in direction of wave propagation due to a change in its transmission medium.

classes.label: Act of Appraisal
classes.definition: An Act of Measuring that involves evaluating, assessing, estimating, or judging the nature, value, importance, condition, or quality of something or someone. In the context of an Act of Appraisal, the terms 'value', 'condition', and 'quality' do not have the same meanings as their counterparts that are defined in the Common Core Ontologies. For example, a knife may be appraised to be of high quality if it is sharp and sturdy or to be of inferior quality if it is dull or fragile.
examples: a food critic rating the quality of a restaurant's ambiance, service, and food
a mechanic assessing whether a damaged vehicle is repairable
an insurance agent appraising the financial value of a building

classes.label: Portion of Gaseous Propellant
classes.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a gaseous state.

classes.label: Heat Engine
classes.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert thermal energy into mechanical energy.

classes.label: Mine
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to support the extraction of minerals or other geological materials from an orebody, lode, vein, seam, reef, or placer deposit within the earth.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Email Message
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Message that is transmitted to the recipient's Email Box.

classes.label: Entertainment Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to host activities that are intended to hold the interest of, or give pleasure or delight to, an audience.

classes.label: Gain of Realizable Entity
classes.definition: A Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Realizable Entity.
examples: An informant becomes unreliable (disposition), A person begins to speak French (function), a person becomes a welder (role).

classes.label: Low Frequency
classes.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 30 and 300 kHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 10–1 km

classes.label: Oscillation Process
classes.definition: A Change in which the dependent entity alternates between two or more stases. Oscillation is often thought of in the sense of motion, e.g., a swinging clock pendulum. However, the repetitive variation in location around a central point is technically a process of vibration, sometimes referred to as mechanical oscillation. Use the term Vibration Motion for those cases.

classes.label: Permanent Resident
classes.definition: A person with a Permanent Resident Role.

classes.label: Highway
classes.definition: A Road that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to travel on routes that connect relatively major destinations.

classes.label: Organization Member
classes.definition: A Person who is affiliated with some Organization by being a member of that Organization.

classes.label: Color Brightness
classes.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect or radiate light.

classes.label: Non-Name Identifier
classes.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that consists of a string of characters that designates an entity within a specified namespace or context, is not a Designative Name, may be automatically or randomly generated, and typically has no preexisting cultural or social significance.

classes.label: Ground Moving Target Indication Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Moving Target Indication Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to identify and track entities moving on or near the ground.

classes.label: Containing Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which one entity contains another.

classes.label: Decoy
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to distract or conceal what an individual or group might be looking for.

classes.label: Algorithm
classes.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some Process and contains a finite sequence of unambiguous instructions in order to achieve some Objective.

classes.label: Act of Terrorism
classes.definition: An Act of Violence which creates fear and which is prescribed by religious, political or ideological objectives, and which deliberately target or disregard the safety of civilians and are committed by members of non-government organizations.

classes.label: Mailing Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed for the systematic physical transportation of documents and packages.

classes.label: Radiological Weapon
classes.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of releasing radioactive material.

classes.label: Distance Measurement Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the spatial Distance to a specified object or class of objects.

classes.label: Missile Launcher
classes.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Precision-Guided Missiles.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Torque
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate of change of angular momentum of an object.
altLabels: Measurement Unit of Moment of Force

classes.label: Effect
classes.definition: A Process that follows and is caused by some previous Process.

classes.label: Government Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which public policy is administered and the actions of its members are directed.

classes.label: Material Territory of a Government Domain
classes.definition: The portions of lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a Government Domain

classes.label: Power Transmission Artifact
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to transfer and regulate Power flow from a Power Source to an application point.

classes.label: Radio Relay Station
classes.definition: A Communications Facility that is designed to support the receiving and re-transmitting of radio signals.

classes.label: Cleaning Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to remove foreign objects from another object.

classes.label: Neutral Person
classes.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Neutral Role.

classes.label: Combat Outpost
classes.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to support the conduction of combat operations of limited scope or size.

classes.label: Battery Terminal
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to connect a load or charger to a single or multiple-cell Battery.

classes.label: Distance Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a One-Dimensional Extent inhering in some Site that is externally connected to two Independent Continuants. Displacement (vector) is the shortest possible distance (scalar) between two points. Further thought is needed to adequately handle measurements of distance traveled along a path, e.g., a circuitous path or an arc (such as the surface of a planet), versus the simple case of a direct, straight line between two points.

classes.label: Distribution Port
classes.definition: A Port that is designed with the cargo handling equipment necessary for the loading and unloading of Watercraft

classes.label: Anti-Bacterial Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Anti-Microbial Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death of, some bacterium.

classes.label: Super Low Frequency
classes.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 30 and 300 Hz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 10,000–1,000 km

classes.label: Prosthetic Foot
classes.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing foot.

classes.label: Calendar Year
classes.definition: A Year that begins and ends concurrently with the Days specified by a Calendar System to be the first and last Days of the Year.

classes.label: Sound Wave Process
