classes.definition: A Mechanical Wave Process of Pressure and displacement that is parallel to the propogation direction of the Wave Process through a medium.

classes.label: Act of Inhabitancy
classes.definition: A Planned Act in which a Person lives at a Site for a period of time that may be as short as 1 day/night or as long as the Person's entire life.

classes.label: Product Transport Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to transport some product.

classes.label: Voltage Regulating Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to cause a change in the voltage magnitude between the sending and receiving end of an electrical component.

classes.label: Attitude Control Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in an attitude control process.

classes.label: Medical Depot
classes.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store medical supplies.

classes.label: External Navigation Lighting System
classes.definition: A Lighting System that is designed to be attached to some Vehicle and to emit colored light in order to signal that Vehicle's position, heading, and status.

classes.label: Mirror
classes.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to reflect light that has a wavelength within a given range and is incident on its relflecting surface such that the reflected light maintains most of the characteristics of the original light.

classes.label: Diminutive Name
classes.definition: An Abbreviated Name that is a familiar form of a Proper Name. "Familiar form of a Proper Name" means: that the name is (originally) a short, affectionate version of the fuller name, used (originally) by family or friends.
examples: Alex, Bob, Cathy

classes.label: Act of Contract Formation
classes.definition: An Act of Promising having a lawful object entered into voluntarily by two or more agents with legal capacity, each of whom intends to create one or more legal obligations between them.

classes.label: Government Domain Border
classes.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary of some Government Domain.

classes.label: Designative Information Content Entity
classes.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a set of symbols that designate some Entity.

classes.label: Act of Training Acquisition
classes.definition: An Act of Training performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge from another Agent.

classes.label: Turbofan Air-Breathing Jet Engine
classes.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses a Turbofan, which consists of a Turbine and a Fan.

classes.label: Switch Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process of breaking an electric circuit by interrupting the current or diverting it from one conductor to another.

classes.label: Telecommunication Instrument
classes.definition: A Communication Instrument that is designed for use by some Agent in some Act of Communication where the recipient of that communication is potentially a significant distance away from the Agent.

classes.label: Fuel Tank
classes.definition: A Container that is designed to store a Portion of Fuel.

classes.label: Probability Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the likelihood that a Process or Process Aggregate occurs. Every probability measurement is made within a particular context given certain background assumptions.

classes.label: Mass Specification
classes.definition: A Quality Specification that prescribes the Amount of Mass that a Material Entity should have.

classes.label: Nozzle Mouth
classes.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of the portion of a Nozzle at the end that is designed to be where the flow of fluid exits the Nozzle.

classes.label: Radiolucent
classes.definition: A Radiopacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to permit most X-rays to pass through it.

classes.label: Ideology
classes.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about how some part of the world is or should be and which is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents such that it forms the basis of their beliefs, goals, expectations, and motivations.

classes.label: Enemy Person
classes.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Enemy Role.

classes.label: Convergent-Divergent Nozzle
classes.definition: A Nozzle that consists of a tube with an asymmetric hourglass shape that is designed to accelerate hot pressurized gas by converting the heat energy of the gas flow into kinetic energy as it passes through the Nozzle Throat to generate increased Exhaust Velocity of the gas as it exits the Nozzle. By increasing the Exhaust Velocity of the gas, the Nozzle increases the Thrust generated.

classes.label: Afternoon
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when the sun is at its apex (approximately 12:00pm) and when it sets (approximately 6:00pm).

classes.label: Computer Network
classes.definition: A Telecommunication Network that is designed to allow the exchange of data between two or more computers connected to the network.

classes.label: Wire Receiver
classes.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Wire Antenna to intercept radio signals.

classes.label: Material Copy of an Image
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that represents some entity owing to a visual isomorphism between the carrying artifact and the entity.

classes.label: Material Copy of a System Clock
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Timekeeping Instrument that is part of a computer and is designed to issue a steady high-frequency signal that is used to synchronize all of the computer's internal components.
parents: Material Copy of a Timekeeping Instrument

classes.label: Constructed Tunnel
classes.definition: A Transportation Artifact that is designed to be substantially enclosed, have access constrained to portals, and to enable travel through surrounding soil, earth, or rock formation. This class is not intended to include natural tunnels, such as caves.

classes.label: Power Transmission Line
classes.definition: A Product Transport Facility that is designed to transmit electricity over distance via a system of above ground wires including their supports.

classes.label: Terminal Board
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to join electrical terminations and create an electrical circuit by means of a block which connects individual wires without a splice or physically joining the ends.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Angle
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the angle between two lines or planes in relation to a vertex.
examples: degrees, radians

classes.label: Water Tower
classes.definition: A Facility that is the bearer of functions realized in processes of storing water in an elevated container.

classes.label: Visual Prosthesis
classes.definition: An Artificial Eye that is designed to replace a missing eye, which performs the function of an eye.

classes.label: Command Post Facility
classes.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to support the command and control of Military Operations or Forces.

classes.label: Semi-automatic Pistol
classes.definition: A Hand Gun that has a single fixed firing chamber machined into the rear of the barrel and an ammunition magazine capable of holding multiple Cartridges such that the Hand Gun is designed to automatically reload each time it is fired and to fire a Bullet with each successive pull of the trigger until the stored ammunition is depleted.

classes.label: Acceleration
classes.definition: A Process Profile that is the rate of change of the Velocity of an object.

classes.label: Vehicle
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate the movement of material entities from one location to another by conveying them there.

classes.label: Horn Antenna
classes.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists of a flaring metal waveguide shaped like a horn to direct radio waves in a beam and can be used on its own or as a feeder for larger antenna structures, such as Parabolic Antennas.

classes.label: Prosthesis
classes.definition: A Medical Artifact that is designed to replace a missing body part.

classes.label: Electric Battery
classes.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to produce electric power by converting chemical energy to electrical energy.

classes.label: Fossil Fuel Power Plant
classes.definition: An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert fossil fuels (e.g. coal, natural gas, or petroleum) into electrical energy.

classes.label: Village
classes.definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides that is typically larger than the population of a hamlet but smaller than that of a Town.

classes.label: Counterfeit Instrument
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be a fake replica of some genuine Material Artifact.

classes.label: Cryogenic Storage Dewar
classes.definition: A Container that is designed to store a Portion of Cryogenic Material (such as liquid helium or liquid oxygen) and which consists of, minimally, walls that are constructed from two or more layers that are separated by a high vacuum to provide thermal insulation between the interior and exterior of the dewar.

classes.label: Polarizing Prism
classes.definition: A Prism designed to split a beam of light entering the Prism into components of varying polarization.

classes.label: Sea Level
classes.definition: A Fiat Surface that divides the spheroid composed of Earth and its atmosphere at some point that corresponds to the mean level of calm water in the Earth’s oceans.

classes.label: Vehicle Control System
classes.definition: A Control System that is designed to enable some Agent to control some Vehicle.

classes.label: Parabolic Antenna
classes.definition: A Radio Antenna that uses a parabolic reflector to direct or receive radio waves and has a very high gain.

classes.label: Wedding
classes.definition: An Act of Ceremony in which two Persons are united in Marriage or a similar institution.

classes.label: Decrease of Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in the level of some Dependent Continuant that it bears.

classes.label: Communication Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which one or more Information Content Entities are conveyed from one entity to another.

classes.label: Submillimeter Wavelength Radio Telescope
classes.definition: A Radio Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing radio waves from the submillimeter waveband (i.e. microwaves) to form an enhanced image of the Object. The submillimeter waveband is between the far-infrared and microwave wavebands and is typically taken to have a wavelength of between a few hundred micrometers and a millimeter.

classes.label: Spherical Coordinate System
classes.definition: A Spatial Reference System for three-dimensional spatial regions that identifies each point using an ordered triple of numerical coordinates that consist of the radial distance of the point of interest from a fixed origin, its polar angle measured from a fixed zenith direction, and the azimuth angle of its orthogonal projection measured from a fixed direction on a reference plane that passes through the origin and is orthogonal to the zenith.

classes.label: Hydraulic Power Transfer Unit
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to transfer hydraulic power from one of an Aircraft's hydraulic systems to another in the event that a system has failed or been turned off.

classes.label: Deviation Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which an entity conforms to how it is expected or supposed to be. 'Deviation Measurement Information Content Entity' and 'Veracity Measurement Information Content Entity' are complementary notions. Deviation is a measure of whether reality conforms to an ICE (e.g., a plan or prediction), whereas Veracity is a measure of whether a Descriptive ICE conforms to reality.
examples: a missile impact deviates from its target location by 100 feet
a satellite deviaties from its predicted orbital path by 5 kilometers
an overweight piece of luggage deviates from an airline's maximum allowed weight by +10 pounds

classes.label: Microwave Frequency
classes.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 MHz and 300 GHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 1,000–1 mm

classes.label: Spherical
classes.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of all of its cross sections being round.

classes.label: Explosive Land Mine
classes.definition: An Explosive Mine that is designed to be concealed under or on the ground.

classes.label: Geospatial Region Bounding Box Identifier List
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit of Geocoordinate that is comprised of 4 pairs of coordinates, one for each of the 4 defining points (North, West, South, East) of a Geospatial Region Bounding Box.

classes.label: Transducer
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert one form of energy to another.

classes.label: Forward Operations Base
classes.definition: A Military Base that is located relatively close to an offensive Area of Operations, is supported by the Base of Operations, and is designed to support local strategic objectives and tactical operations.

classes.label: Length
classes.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's greatest extent in one direction.

classes.label: Act of Sojourn
classes.definition: An Act of Inhabitancy in which a Person lives in a dwelling temporarily, often during stages of an Act of Travel.

classes.label: Resource
classes.definition: A Continuant that is owned by, in the possession of, or is otherwise controlled by an Agent such that it could be used by that Agent. Resources are Resources for some Agent. If no instance of Agent existed, no instance of Resource would exist either. It is not a requirement that something be valuable in order for it to be a Resource. Thus the value of something can drastically change without altering whether that thing is a Resource.
examples: a group of interns
a knowledge base
a plot of land
a software program
a sum of money
a vehicle

classes.label: Act of Targeting
classes.definition: A Planned Act wherein some Agent maintains one or more entities as the objects of potential action given some operational requirement.

classes.label: Ignition System
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to produce an Ignition process.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Chart
classes.definition: A Material Copy of an Image that is designed to carry some Representational Information Content Entity that is prescribed by some canonical visual format.

classes.label: Act of Social Group Membership
classes.definition: An Act of Association wherein a Person belongs to some Social Group.

classes.label: Point Estimate Information Content Entity
classes.definition: An Estimate Information Content Entity that consists of a single value for the measured entity.
altLabels: Point Estimate Measurement Information Content Entity

classes.label: Combustion Engine
classes.definition: A Heat Engine that is designed to convert thermal energy that is generated through a local Combustion process into mechanical energy.

classes.label: Canal
classes.definition: A Water Transportation Artifact that is an artificial Hydrographic Feature designed to convey water or enable Watercraft to travel inland.

classes.label: Bullet
classes.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be projected by a Firearm, Sling, Slingshot, or Air Gun, but which does not (typically) contain explosives.

classes.label: Julian Day Number
classes.definition: A Decimal Date Identifier that designates some Julian Day by using a number to indicate the sequential ordering of the Day since the Julian Date epoch.

classes.label: Text Messaging
classes.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication occurs through the exchange of brief written messages between fixed-line phone or mobile phone and fixed or portable devices over a network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

classes.label: Action Permission
classes.definition: A Process Regulation that permits some Process.

classes.label: Wave Process Profile
classes.definition: A Process Profile of a Wave Process. This is a defined class used to group process profiles of Wave Processes. Note that not every relevant process profile can be asserted as a subtype, however, because they (e.g. Frequency and Amplitude) are applicable to other processes as well (e.g. Oscillation Process).

classes.label: Ultra Low Frequency
classes.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 Hz and 3 kHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 1,000–100 km

classes.label: Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency
classes.definition: A Frequency that is characterized by the rate of Oscillations per second of an Electromagnetic Wave. Divisions between EM radiation frequencies are fiat and sources vary on where to draw boundaries.

classes.label: Zenith
classes.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that extends from a given location upward along the local vertical direction pointing in the direction opposite the apparent Gravitational Force at that location.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Database
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some set of specific Information Content Entities and to be rapidly searchable and retrievable.

classes.label: Synagogue
classes.definition: A Religious Facility that is designed for Judaic worship and prayer.

classes.label: Component Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity having a discrete structure in virtue of that entity being part of a system considered at a particular level of analysis.

classes.label: Color Saturation
classes.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect high intensity light distributed across fewer wavelengths, typically considered on a continuum of purity.

classes.label: Surface Wave Profile
classes.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the Wave Process propogates along the surface of a medium and which involves both transverse and longitudinal wave profiles such that the motion of the displacement of participating particles is circular or elliptical.
examples: the motion of an ocean wave

classes.label: Pier
classes.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed to partially enclose a harbor and form a landing place for Watercraft.

classes.label: Fungicide Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Anti-Microbial Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death of, some fungus or fungal spore.

classes.label: Velocity
classes.definition: A Process Profile of an object's Motion that is characterized by its Speed and direction with respect to a frame of reference.

classes.label: Optical Focusing Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Optical Processing Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a light focusing event in which the Material Artifact causes the light beam to converge on a target spatial point.

classes.label: Wave Production
classes.definition: A Natural Process in which a Wave Process is generated.

classes.label: Hardness
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which it can be turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

classes.label: Lubrication System
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to contain, transfer, and regulate the flow of lubricant to multiple locations in a Material Artifact. A Lubrication System typical consists of a reservoir, pump, heat exchanger, filter, regulator, valves, sensors, pipes, and hoses. In some cases it also includes the passageways and openings within the artifact it is designed to lubricate. For example, the oil holes in a bearing and crankshaft.

classes.label: Amount
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the total, aggregate or sum of a number of discrete items or material the entity contains as parts.

classes.label: Act of Requesting
classes.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by asking for something.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Density
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the mass of an object per unit of its total volume.

classes.label: Imaging Instrument
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to bear an Imaging Artifact Function.

classes.label: Impulsive Force
classes.definition: A Process Profile that is the integral of a Force that is applied to a portion of matter over a period of time. An Impulse changes the Momentum (and potentially also the direction of Motion) of the object it is applied to and is typically measured in Newton meters.

classes.label: Curvilinear Motion
classes.definition: A Translational Motion process in which an Object moves along a curved path.

classes.label: Video Camera
classes.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and digitally or physically record a continuous stream of subsequent images of an entity or scene such that the images can be played back in succession as a video.

classes.label: Locomotive
classes.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that is designed to provide the motive power for a Train.

classes.label: Signal Detection Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in the process of discerning between information-bearing patterns and random patterns, or noise, that distract from the information.

classes.label: Hydraulic Motor
classes.definition: A Physically Powered Engine that converts hydraulic pressure and flow into torque and angular displacement.

classes.label: Chemical Depot
classes.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store chemicals.

classes.label: Portion of Cryosphere
classes.definition: A fiat object part of the frozen part of a natural satellite's hydosphere

classes.label: Ethnicity
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in its bearers by virtue of a common heritage, often consisting of a common language, a common culture (often including a shared religion) and an ideology that stresses common ancestry or endogamy.

classes.label: Control System
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to manage, command, direct, or regulate the behavior of at least one other Material Artifact.

classes.label: Factory
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed for manufacturing or refining material products.

classes.label: Stasis of Non-Mission Capable Maintenance
classes.definition: A Stasis of Non-Mission Capable during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing its primary functions for the specified Mission due to participating in an Act Of Maintenance.

classes.label: Optical Property
classes.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that is realized when its bearer interacts with electromagnetic waves within the visible light spectrum.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

classes.label: Radio Repeater
classes.definition: A Radio Transceiver that is designed to receive a radio signal, amplify it, and retransmit it (often on another frequency).

classes.label: Increase of Role
classes.definition: An Increase of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Role that it bears.

classes.label: Altitude
classes.definition: A Height that inheres in a Site that externally connects an Independent Continuant to either the surface of the Earth or the Earth's mean Sea Level.

classes.label: Turbine Steam Engine
classes.definition: A Steam Engine that is designed to extract thermal energy from pressurized steam and use it to do mechanical work on a rotating output shaft.

classes.label: Translational Motion
classes.definition: A Motion Process in which the participating Object changes its position from one portion of space to another.

classes.label: Direct Current Power Source
classes.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to transfer electrical power in the form of direct current.

classes.label: Chemical Reaction Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process that leads to the transformation of one set of chemical substances to another.

classes.label: Catadioptric Optical Telescope
classes.definition: An Optical Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light through the use of a combination of Lenses and Mirrors to form an enhanced image of the Object.

classes.label: Fuel Ventilation System
classes.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to allow air into the Fuel Tank to take the place of burned fuel.

classes.label: Geospatial Ellipse
classes.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary that is formed by following a symmetric arc between four vertices which are connected to the center point of the ellipse via a straight line.

classes.label: Electrical Conduction Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact being used to conduct an electric current.

classes.label: Rail Transport Vehicle
classes.definition: A Ground Vehicle that is designed to convey cargo, passengers, or equipment by Railway.

classes.label: Hazel
classes.definition: A Color that is a combination of Brown and Green, typically associated with eye color.

classes.label: Information Bearing Artifact
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that carries an Information Content Entity and is designed to do so using a particular format or structure. This class continues to use the word ‘bearing’ in its rdfs:label for legacy reasons. It should be understood that all instances of this class are carriers of information content entities and only, strictly speaking, a bearer of their concretizations.

classes.label: Material Copy of a List
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that consists of one or more Information Bearing Artifacts that carry Information Content Entities and are the subjects of some Sequence Position Ordinality.

classes.label: Day
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to the approximate length of time required for an Astronomical Body to complete one rotation around its Rotational Axis as specified relative to a particular Temporal Reference System. Unless otherwise specified, a Day is assumed to be relative to the rotational motion of the Earth and is approximately equal to a twenty-four hour temporal region for which the start and end times are specified by the Temporal Reference System used.

classes.label: y-Axis
classes.definition: A Coordinate System Axis designated by the variable 'y'.

classes.label: Stage
classes.definition: An Entertainment Facility that is designed to provide a space upon which entertaining performances or productions can occur.

classes.label: Round
classes.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of every point along its circumference being equidistant from the center.

classes.label: Prism
classes.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to refract light and which consists of a transparent material with flat polished surfaces where at least two of these surfaces have an angle between them.

classes.label: Coiled
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer being wound in concentric rings or spirals.

classes.label: Power Tool
classes.definition: A Tool that is designed to be actuated by a Power Source and mechanism other than or in addition to manual labor.

classes.label: Compression Ignition Engine
classes.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that is designed to operate by igniting a portion of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture using heat generated via compression of the mixture.

classes.label: Reactant Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which a substance or compound is added to a system in order to bring about a chemical reaction and is consumed in the course of the reaction.

classes.label: Submersible Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of operating while submerged in water.

classes.label: Multi-Week Temporal Interval
classes.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Weeks and spans at least one Week. This is a defined class.

classes.label: Radio Wave Conversion Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact being used to convert electric power into radio waves or radio waves into electric power.

classes.label: Electromagnetic Pulse
classes.definition: An Electromagnetic Wave Process that consists of a short high-energy burst of electromagnetic energy.

classes.label: Portion of Nuclear Fuel
classes.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to be used in a nuclear fission process to produce energy.

classes.label: Water Treatment Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed for making water more acceptable for a specific end-use.

classes.label: Folded
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of one part of the bearer being layered over another connected part.

classes.label: Portion of Liquid Nitrogen
classes.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid nitrogen.

classes.label: Geospatial Line String
classes.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary that has two or more Geospatial Positions as vertices, where each vertex is connected to only one other vertex by a straight line.

classes.label: Orange
classes.definition: A Color that is between Red and Yellow with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 590 to 635 nanometers.

classes.label: Stasis
classes.definition: A Process in which one or more Independent Continuants endure in an unchanging condition.

classes.label: Stasis of Function
classes.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant bears some Function that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

classes.label: Act of Promising
classes.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by declaring that the promising agent will do, or refrain from doing, the specified action.

classes.label: Very Low Frequency
classes.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 kHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 100–10 km

classes.label: Optical Communication Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of visible light.

classes.label: Stasis of Role
classes.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant bears some Role that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

classes.label: Telecommunication Network Line
classes.definition: A Communication Artifact that is designed to be the physical transmission medium that connects two or more Telecommunication Network Nodes within a Telecommunication Network to facilitate communication between the Nodes.

classes.label: Refractivity
classes.definition: A Radiation Reflectivity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to change the direction of a propagating wave when passing through it.

classes.label: Time of Day Identifier
classes.definition: A Temporal Instant Identifier that designates some Time of Day.

classes.label: Pesticide Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Poison Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a living thing that is detrimental to humans or human concerns.

classes.label: Time Zone Identifier
classes.definition: A Spatial Region Identifier that designates the region associated with some uniform standard time for legal, commercial, or social purposes. Standards of date, time, and time zone data formats: ISO/WD 8601-2 ( W3C (

classes.label: Speed
classes.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the magnitude of an object's motion with respect to a frame of reference during some time period. An object's speed is the scalar absolute value of it's Velocity.

classes.label: Herbicide Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death to, unwanted plants.

classes.label: Year
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to the approximate length of time required for an Astronomical Body to complete one Orbital Revolution around its Primary Body as specified relative to a particular Temporal Reference System. Unless otherwise specified, a Year is assumed to be relative to the Orbiting of the Earth around the Sun and is approximately equal to 12 Months or 365 Days.

classes.label: Julian Date Identifier
classes.definition: A Decimal Time of Day Identifier that designates a Julian Date and is composed of both a Julian Day Number and a Julian Date Fraction.

classes.label: Mid Infrared Light Frequency
classes.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 20 and 214 terahertz.

classes.label: Body Shape
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a Person's body by virtue of the body's general outline or figure.

classes.label: Act of Financial Instrument Use
classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Financial Instrument.

classes.label: Family
classes.definition: A Group of Persons related to one another by ancestry or marriage.

classes.label: Portion of Fuel
classes.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to release thermal energy when reacted with other substances.

classes.label: Act of Donating
classes.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is tranfered by an Agent (the Donor) to another Agent (the Recipient) without return consideration.

classes.label: Bicycle
classes.definition: A Ground Vehicle that consists of two wheels, one in front of the other, attached to a frame along with handlebars and pedals such that it is designed to receive its motive power from pedaling.

classes.label: Explosive Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of the rapid increase in volume and release of energy in an extreme manner.

classes.label: Sub-Bass Frequency
classes.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 20 and 60 Hz.

classes.label: Solar Panel
classes.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of one or more photovoltaic (i.e. solar) cells that convert light energy (photons) directly into electricity by means of the photovoltaic effect.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Temperature
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the thermal energy in an object.
examples: celsius, fahrenheit, kelvin

classes.label: Proportional Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a portion of a whole (described by the numerator) compared against that whole (described by the denominator) where the whole is a nominally described set of like entities. A percentage is one way to express a proportional measure where the decimal expression of the proportion is multiplied by 100, thus giving the proportional value with respect to a whole of 100. E.g., the ratio of pigs to cows on a farm is 44 to 79 (44:79 or 44/79). The proportion of pigs to total animals is 44 to 123 or 44/123. The percentage of pigs is the decimal equivalent of the proportion (0.36) multiplied by a 100 (36%). The percentage can be expressed as a proportion where the numerator value is transformed for a denominator of 100, i.e., 36 of a 100 animals are pigs (36/100).

classes.label: Hydroelectric Power Plant
classes.definition: An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert hydropower into electrical power.

classes.label: Active Stasis
classes.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is realizing one or more of its designed Artifact Functions (especially one of its primary functions).

classes.label: Mounted Gun
classes.definition: A Firearm that is designed to be fired while mounted.

classes.label: Heating System
classes.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to heat the air or objects in a Site.

classes.label: Stasis of Quality
classes.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears some Quality that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

classes.label: Light Machine Gun
classes.definition: A Long Gun that is designed to fire bullets in quick succession from an ammunition belt or magazine and to be employed by an individual soldier, with or without assistance, and typically weighing 9-22 lbs.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Work
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of displacements of points to which Forces have been applied.
examples: joule, erg, kilowatt hour

classes.label: Descriptive Information Content Entity
classes.definition: An Information Content Entity that describes some Entity.

classes.label: Decrease of Realizable Entity
classes.definition: A Decrease of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Realizable Entity that it bears.

classes.label: Effect of Location Change
classes.definition: An Effect caused by some Act of Location Change and which results in an Object being located in a different place.

classes.label: Artifact History
classes.definition: A History of a Material Artifact.

classes.label: Ultra High Frequency Communication Instrument
classes.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is designed to participate in some process that has process part some Ultra High Frequency.

classes.label: Improvised Explosive Device
classes.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be used in non-conventional military action.

classes.label: Television Broadcast
classes.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience occurs via transmissions through a television network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

classes.label: Allied Person
classes.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Ally Role.

classes.label: Split
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a linear opening, or having been divided into parts.

classes.label: Sound Process Profile
classes.definition: A Process Profile that is part of a sound reception process and is characterized by properties of incoming sound waves as they are translated by some sensory system.

classes.label: Act of Confessing
classes.definition: An Act of Representative Communication in which a person makes an admission of misdeeds or faults.

classes.label: Public Safety Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of preventing and responding to events that could endanger the safety of the general public from significant danger, injury/harm, or damage, such as crimes or disasters (natural or man-made).

classes.label: Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Loss of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Specifically Dependent Continuant.

classes.label: Radio Broadcast
classes.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience is mediated through radio waves transmitted through a radio network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

classes.label: Pipeline
classes.definition: A Product Transport Facility that is designed to transport goods or materials through a pipe.

classes.label: Rocket Pod
classes.definition: A Rocket Launcher that is designed to contain several Unguided Rockets held in individual tubes and to be used by Aircraft or Helicopters for close air support.

classes.label: Optical Camera
classes.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and record an image generated from visible light.

classes.label: Infrastructure System
classes.definition: A Material Entity that is composed of elements bearing Infrastructure Roles and is by itself sufficient to provide a planned service or benefit to some organization that maintains its elements.

classes.label: Plant
classes.definition: An Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, autotrophic, and has cells that contain chloroplasts and walls made of cellulose.

classes.label: Brown
classes.definition: A Color that consists of dark orange and red, and of very low intensity.

classes.label: Physiographic Feature
classes.definition: A Geographic Feature that is a geomorphological unit characterized by its surface form and location in the landscape.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Video
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity in the form of a sequence of representations that are presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity.

classes.label: Act of Personal Communication
classes.definition: An Act of Communication that the sender intends to be received by a small audience. An Act of Personal Communication is distinct from an Act of Mass Media Communication only in terms of the size of the intended audience. The use of media typically need not require that the communication have a large audience, e.g., a Radio Broadcast on an obscure frequency that you use to communicate with your best friend.

classes.label: Loss of Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer or carrier of some Dependent Continuant.

classes.label: Brake Control System
classes.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to control the process of braking with the aim of preventing rolling, skidding, and hydroplaning.

classes.label: Identification Friend or Foe Transponder
classes.definition: A Radio Transponder that is designed to automatically transmit a predefined signal in response to receiving an appropriate interrogation signal such that the entity it is located on can be positively identified as friendly.

classes.label: Act of Religious Group Affiliation
classes.definition: An Act of Association wherein some Person belongs to some Religious Demonination or sub-Denomination.

classes.label: Religious Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes related to worship and prayer.

classes.label: Storage Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to store materials or goods.

classes.label: Wind Farm
classes.definition: An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert the wind's kinetic energy into electrical power by means of wind turbines.

classes.label: Act of Inviting
classes.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by requesting the presence or participation of the audience, and which may include offering an incentive or inducement.

classes.label: Act of Loaning
classes.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is given by an Agent (the Creditor) to another Agent (the Debtor) in order to receive Repayments from the Debtor which are of greater Financial Value.

classes.label: Wavy
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having a sinuous or rippled border.

classes.label: Wired Communication Reception Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Communication Reception Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact receives information transmitted from another Material Artifact, where the transmission of information occurs via a direct connection using an electrical conductor.

classes.label: City
classes.definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a relatively large human population permanently resides; is designated as a city based on a particular administrative, legal, or historical status; and which delimits a local Government that typically oversees the provision of systems for sanitation, utilities, land usage, housing, and transportation.

classes.label: High Frequency Communication Instrument
classes.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is designed to participate in some process that has process part some High Frequency.

classes.label: Visible Observation
classes.definition: An Act of Observation that involves visual perception.

classes.label: Act of Travel
classes.definition: An Act of Location Change wherein one or more Persons move between relatively distant geographical locations for any purpose and any duration, with or without any means of transport.

classes.label: Calendar System
classes.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is designed to organize and identify dates. Calendars typically organize dates through the use of naming and temporal conventions based on Days, Weeks, Months, and Years.

classes.label: Depth
classes.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a downward, backward, or inward direction.

classes.label: Information Medium Artifact
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to have some Information Bearing Artifact as part. An empty notebook, when manufactured, is a medium but not yet a carrier of information content. However, a book, in the sense of a novel or collection of philosophical essays or poems, depends necessarily on it carrying some information content. Thus, there are no empty books. Likewise, there are no empty databases, only portions of digital storage that have not yet been configured to carry some information content according to a database software application.
examples: A magnetic hard drive
A notebook

classes.label: Decimal Date Identifier
classes.definition: A Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a number to indicate the sequential ordering of the Day since a specified Reference Time.

classes.label: Married
classes.definition: A Stasis of Generically Dependent Continuant that consists of a socially, culturally, or ritually recognized union or legal contract between spouses that establishes rights and obligations between them, between them and their children, and between them and their in-laws.

classes.label: Mean Point Estimate Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Point Estimate Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the sum of all the values in the set divided by the total number of values in the set.

classes.label: Portion of Oxidizer
classes.definition: A Portion of Material that is disposed to steal electrons from other substances (i.e. to oxidize other substances) as a participant in a reduction-oxidation process. Oxidizers are essential participants in many processes including combustion and rusting. Hence, a portion of oxidizer must always be present along with a portion of fuel in order for combustion to occur.
examples: oxygen, hydrogen peroxide, chlorine, sulfiric acid, potassium nitrate

classes.label: Geopolitical Power Role
classes.definition: A Role had by an Organization, that is perceived by an International Community as capable of performing influential acts in that community, and which would be realized in performing such acts.

classes.label: Radio Communication Relay Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Communication Relay Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to first receive and then transmit information without the use of wires from one Material Artifact to another for the purpose of communiction.

classes.label: Decontamination Facility
classes.definition: A Washing Facility that is designed to wash personnel or equipment after (potential) contamination by radioactive, biological, or chemical material.

classes.label: Act of Facility Use
classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which an Agent makes use of some Facility.

classes.label: Radio Communication Instrument
classes.definition: A Communication Instrument that is designed to enable communication between two or more entities via the use of radio waves.

classes.label: Vehicle Track
classes.definition: An Object Track for a Vehicle during some motion.

classes.label: Post Office
classes.definition: A Mailing Facility that is designed for serving customers of the national postal system.

classes.label: Email Box
classes.definition: A Telecommunication Instrument that is designed to be the delivery destination of Email Messages that are addressed to the corresponding Email Address.

classes.label: Telephone
classes.definition: A Telecommunication Instrument that is designed to provide point-to-point communication between agents by means of audio messages.

classes.label: Act of Material Artifact Processing
classes.definition: A Planned Act of performing a series of physical operations on a material artifact in order to change or preserve the artifact.

classes.label: Emergency AC/DC Power Source
classes.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to provide electrical power in an emergency situation by means of both alternating current and direct current.

classes.label: Amplitude
classes.definition: A Process Profile of an Oscillation Process that is the absolute value of the maximum displacement from a zero, equilibrium, or mean value during one cycle of the Oscillation Process.

classes.label: Semi-Major Axis
classes.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that is equal to half the length of the Major Axis of an Ellipse.

classes.label: Pyramidal
classes.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having a polygonal base with vertices that all connect to the same apex to form triangular faces.

classes.label: Maroon
classes.definition: A Color consisting of purple and brown hue.

classes.label: Group of Persons
classes.definition: A Group of Agents that has only Persons as member parts.

classes.label: Acronym
classes.definition: An Abbreviated Name that combines the initial letters of a Designative Name and which is pronounced as a word.
examples: Wi-Fi, ASCII, OPSEC

classes.label: Lunar Calendar System
classes.definition: A Calendar System that is designed to organize and identify dates based on the cycles of the Moon's phases.

classes.label: Permanent Resident Role
classes.definition: A role inhering in a Person by virtue of that Person being recognized as having legal resident status in a Government Domain in which that person is not a citizen but where they have the right to reside on a permanent basis.

classes.label: Telecommunication Network Node
classes.definition: A Communication Artifact that consists of a connection point, redistribution point, or endpoint that is designed to be part of a Telecommunication Network and can be either active or passive.

classes.label: Parts List
classes.definition: A Quality Specification that prescribes the Amount of some type of Material Artifact that are part of or located on another Material Artifact.

classes.label: Death
classes.definition: A Natural Process in which all biological functions that sustain a living organism cease.

classes.label: Calendar Day
classes.definition: A Day that begins and ends concurrently with the Seconds specified by a Calendar System to be the first and last Seconds of the Day.

classes.label: Act of Arrival
classes.definition: An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity reaching its destination such that the larger Act of Location Change is completed.

classes.label: Arbitrary Identifier
classes.definition: A Non-Name Identifier that consists of a string of characters that does not follow an encoding system.

classes.label: Beginning of Life Stasis
classes.definition: A Operational Stasis that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is first put into operational use such that its designed set of Artifact Functions is capable of operating at or near their designed peak performance levels. A Beginning of Life Stasis (BoL) is a relatively brief Operational Stasis that is primarily of interest for the purpose of establishing a baseline for operational parameters to be compared to the designed specifications as well as the Material Artifact's performance throughout its operational life.

classes.label: Act of Military Training Acquisition
classes.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of Military Operations from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Military Organization.

classes.label: Act of Apologizing
classes.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by acknowledging and expressing regret for a fault, shortcoming, or failure.

classes.label: Bass Frequency
classes.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 60 and 250 Hz.

classes.label: Train Car
classes.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a single Vehicle that is not a Train but is designed to be connected to other Train Cars along with at least one Locomotive to form a Train.

classes.label: Part Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being part of some other entity without being subject to further subdivision or disassembly without destruction of its designated use.

classes.label: Nickel-metal Hydride Electric Battery
classes.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a metal-hydride anode and nickel oxide hydroxide cathode.

classes.label: Computing Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a computation process.

classes.label: Landline Telephone
classes.definition: A Telephone that is connected to a Telephone Network through a pair of wires.

classes.label: Constituent State
classes.definition: A First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits a centralized regional Government that holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the State.

classes.label: Act of Legal Instrument Use
classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Legal Instrument.

classes.label: Deactivated Stasis
classes.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is not realizing any of its designed Artifact Functions (or at least not realizing any of its primary functions).

classes.label: Inhibiting Motion Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to inhibit the motion of some object.

classes.label: Financial Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of managing money.

classes.label: Geospatial Line
classes.definition: A Geospatial Line String that has only two vertices.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Momentum
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the Momentum of a portion of matter that is in Motion.
examples: kg m/s, slug ft/s, g m/s

classes.label: Phosphorescence
classes.definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light after absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, and to continue emitting after the absorbing process has ceased.

classes.label: Sniper Rifle
classes.definition: A Rifle that is designed to be highly accurate for long-range precision tactical shooting.

classes.label: Ocular Prosthesis
classes.definition: An Artificial Eye that is designed to replace a missing eye, but which does not function as an eye.

classes.label: Thermal Imaging Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to create a visual representation of an entity using radiation from the far infrared region of the electromagnetic spectrum that the entity emits

classes.label: X-ray Telescope
classes.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing X-rays to form an enhanced image of the Object.

classes.label: Government Building
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed for the administration of a community.

classes.label: Temperature Measurement Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Temperature of a specified object or class of objects.

classes.label: Act of Religious Worship
classes.definition: An Act of Ceremony wherein there occurs acts of religious devotion usually directed towards a deity.

classes.label: Act of Consumption
classes.definition: A Planned Act in which a resource is ingested or used up.

classes.label: Act of Maintenance
classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Modification in which a Material Artifact is modified in order to preserve or restore one or more of its designed Qualities or Functions.

classes.label: Electromagnetic Wave Process
classes.definition: A Wave Process that is produced by charged particles, involves the periodic Oscillation of electric and magnetic fields at right angles to each other and the direction of wave propogation such that it has a Transverse Wave Profile, and which transfers electromagnetic radiant energy through a portion of space or matter.

classes.label: Electric Motor
classes.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert electrical energy into mechanical energy.

classes.label: Pitch
classes.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the frequency of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from low to high.

classes.label: Telecommunication Infrastructure
classes.definition: An Infrastructure System that is designed to support the use of Telecommunication Instruments to communicate.

classes.label: Angular Momentum
classes.definition: A Momentum that is the product of an object's moment of inertia and its Angular Velocity.

classes.label: Highway Interchange
classes.definition: A Road Junction that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to exit one or more Highways and enter another Highway without directly crossing any other traffic stream.

classes.label: Reservoir
classes.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store water in a man-made open enclosure or area.

classes.label: Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Generically Dependent Continuant that generically depends on some Information Bearing Entity and stands in relation of aboutness to some Entity. Information Content Entity is here intended to be a class of Entities whose instances are the informational content of Information Bearing Entities. For example, three instances of information bearers -- such as a bar chart, color-coded map, and a written report -- each of which lists the GDP of Countries for the year 2010 are each different carriers of the same information content. It is this content that is generically dependent upon its carrier. This treatment of Informational Content Entity (cf. the Information Artifact Ontology) leads to a principle of subtyping based upon the relationship that ICE's have with the Entity they are about rather than characteristics such as format, language, measurement scale, or media. The latter are treated here as being Qualities of bearers.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Frequency
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the number of times an event repeats per unit of time.
examples: hertz, revolutions per minute

classes.label: Fixed Line Network Telephone Call
classes.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a telephone network where the telephones are wired into a single telephone exchange.

classes.label: Current Conversion Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert some electrical current.

classes.label: Portion of Liquid Propellant
classes.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a liquid state.

classes.label: Fuel Transfer System
classes.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to facilitate the transfer of some Portion of Fuel from the Fuel Tank for use in some Engine.

classes.label: Medium Frequency
classes.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 kHz and 3 MHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 1,000–100 m

classes.label: Prescriptive Information Content Entity
classes.definition: An Information Content Entity that prescribes some Entity.

classes.label: Height
classes.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a vertical direction.

classes.label: Assault Rifle
classes.definition: A Rifle that is designed to have selective-fire functionality and use an intermediate Cartridge and a detachable magazine.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Speed
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the rates at which objects traverse distance.
examples: miles per hour, kilometers per hour, knot, mach

classes.label: Act of Artifact Modification
classes.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing in which an existing Material Artifact is acted upon in a manner that changes, adds, or removes one or more of its Qualities, Dispositions, or Functions. Excluded from this class are instances of role change or role creation such as the introduction of an artifact as a piece of evidence in a trial or the loading of artifacts onto a ship for transport.

classes.label: Act of Deceptive Communication
classes.definition: Ac Act of Communication intended to mislead the audience by distortion or falsification of evidence and induce a reaction that is prejudicial to the interests of the audience.

classes.label: Decimal Time of Day Identifier
classes.definition: A Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Day and is specified using a decimal value for the portion of the Day that preceded the Temporal Instant.

classes.label: Plan
classes.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some set of intended Intentional Acts through which some Agent expects to achieve some Objective.

classes.label: Cyan
classes.definition: A Color that is between Green and Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 490 and 520 nanometers.

classes.label: Political Orientation
classes.definition: An Ideology that characterizes the political thinking of an Agent or Group of Agents, usually with respect to the political environment within a particular nation.

classes.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Documentary
classes.definition: An Act of Publishing a factual record or report.

classes.label: Cause
classes.definition: A Process that is the cause of or one of the causes of some other Process.

classes.label: Closure
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which that bearer affords passage or sightline through it via an opening, aperture, orifice, or vent.

classes.label: Portion of Waste Material
classes.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that serves no further use in terms of the initial user's own purposes of production, transformation, or consumption such that the Agent wants to dispose of it.

classes.label: Act of Portion of Material Consumption
classes.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which a Portion of Material is expended.

classes.label: Decrease of Function
classes.definition: A Decrease of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Function that it bears.

classes.label: Shear Wave Process
classes.definition: A Mechanical Wave that has a Transverse Wave Profile.

classes.label: Occupation Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill within the context of some Act of Employment.

classes.label: Thermal Insulation Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Thermal Control Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact prevents or reduces the transfer of heat between objects that are in thermal contact or in range of radiative influence.

classes.label: Scar
classes.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of fibrous connective tissue on skin or within body tissue and which was formed due to an injury that has not healed completely.

classes.label: Citizen Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in a Person by virtue of that Person being legally recognized as a member of a particular state, with associated rights and obligations.

classes.label: Reflective Prism
classes.definition: A Prism designed to reflect light in order to flip, invert, rotate, deviate, or displace a beam of light entering the Prism.

classes.label: Super High Frequency
classes.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 3 and 30 GHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 100–10 mm

classes.label: Nickname
classes.definition: A Designative Name that is a familiar or humorous substitute for an entity's Proper Name.
examples: Ike, Chief, P-Fox

classes.label: Bent
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more angles along its border.

classes.label: Second
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to the duration of 9,192,631,770 periods of the radiation corresponding to the transition between the two hyperfine levels of the ground state of the cesium 133 atom. The Second is used as the basic SI unit of time.

classes.label: Power Rectifying Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Current Conversion Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).

classes.label: Electrical Power Production Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to generate electrical power.

classes.label: Material Artifact
classes.definition: A Material Entity that was designed by some Agent to realize a certain Function.

classes.label: Ramjet Engine
classes.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses the forward motion of the Engine to compress incoming air (without the use of an axial compressor) and decelerate it to subsonic speeds before adding the fuel and constantly combusting the mixture then expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

classes.label: Disrupting Disposition
classes.definition: A disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process some entity has an interest in.

classes.label: Telecommunication Network
classes.definition: A Communication System that is designed to enable the transmission of information over significant distances between Telecommunication Endpoints via Telecommunication Network Nodes and Lines.

classes.label: Defunct Stasis
classes.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact no longer maintains its designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least no longer maintains its primary functions).

classes.label: Spray Nozzle
classes.definition: A Nozzle that is designed to facilitate a conversion of the flow of a portion of liquid into a dynamic collection of drops dispersed in a portion of gas.

classes.label: Drooping
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a border that hangs downwards.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Message
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that is relatively brief and to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

classes.label: Cartridge
classes.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to package a Bullet, a propellant substance, and a primer within a case that is designed to fit within the firing chamber of a Firearm.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Electromagnetic Force
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the electromagnetic force between electrically charged entities.
examples: volt, ampere, coulomb

classes.label: Turbojet Air-Breathing Jet Engine
classes.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses a Turbojet, which consists of a Turbine with a Propelling Nozzle.

classes.label: Operator Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent's responsibilities to operate or control some Material Artifact.
examples: the role of driving a car
the role of flying an airplane
the role of operating a crane

classes.label: Passenger Train Car
classes.definition: A Train Car that is designed to transport passengers.

classes.label: Biological Weapon
classes.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, incapacity, or death by means of releasing disease-producing agents—such as bacteria, viruses, or fungi.

classes.label: Optical Telescope
classes.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light to form an enhanced image of the Object.

classes.label: Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that places an Entity into some rank order. Four of the subtypes of measurements used here (Interval, Nominal, Ordinal, and Ratio) were originally defined by S.S. Stevens in the article "On the Theory of Scales of Measurement" in Science, Vol. 103 No. 2684 on June 7, 1946. For an introductory article with links to additional content including criticisms and alternate classifications of measurements see
examples: The sentence "The coldest day in history in Chicago, IL. is January 20, 1985." is the carrier of an ordinal measurment.
a measurement that places Geospatial Regions into a rank order of small, medium, large
a measurement that places military units onto a readiness rank order of red, yellow, green

classes.label: Automobile
classes.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a small number of passengers while traveling on four tired wheels.

classes.label: Heating Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the thermal energy of a system increases.

classes.label: Proper Name
classes.definition: A Designative Name that is an official name for a particular entity.

classes.label: Controlled-Access Highway
classes.definition: A Highway that is designed for high-speed vehicular traffic, with traffic flow and ingress/egress regulated.

classes.label: Portion of Lithosphere
classes.definition: A fiat object part of the rigid, outermost rocky shell of a natural satellite.

classes.label: Agent
classes.definition: A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability.

classes.label: Equipment Cooling System
classes.definition: A Cooling System that is designed to cool some piece of equipment.

classes.label: Steering Control System
classes.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to control the direction some Vehicle is traveling.

classes.label: Portion of Gaseous Fuel
classes.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a gaseous state.

classes.label: Act of Denying
classes.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by either asserting that something is not true or real or refusing to satisfy a request or desire.

classes.label: Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that places a Quality of an Entity onto an interval scale having a true zero value. Four of the subtypes of measurements used here (Interval, Nominal, Ordinal, and Ratio) were originally defined by S.S. Stevens in the article "On the Theory of Scales of Measurement" in Science, Vol. 103 No. 2684 on June 7, 1946. For an introductory article with links to additional content including criticisms and alternate classifications of measurements see
examples: The sentence "The temperature reached 240.372 degrees Kelvin on January 20, 1985 in Chicago, IL." is the carrier of a ratio measurement as 0 degrees on the Kelvin scale does describe absolute zero.
a measurement of the barometric pressure at 1,000 feet above sea level
a measurement of the measure of air temperature on the Kelvin scale
a measurement of the number of members in an Organization

classes.label: Calendar Week
classes.definition: A Week that begins and ends concurrently with the Days specified by a Calendar System to be the first and last Days of the Week.

classes.label: Spark Ignition Engine
classes.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that is designed to operate by generating a spark to ignite a portion of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture.

classes.label: Electric Generator
classes.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to convert mechanical energy to electrical energy for use in an external circuit.

classes.label: Pointing Orientation
classes.definition: A Spatial Orientation of a Material Entity in which one or more of its designated components are oriented toward a specified direction.

classes.label: Trim Tab
classes.definition: A Control Surface that is designed to counteract hydro-, aerodynamic, or other forces in order to stabilize the Vehicle it is part of in the desired Attitude.

classes.label: Mechanical Wave Process
classes.definition: A Wave Process that involves Oscillation of a portion of matter such that energy is transferred through the material medium.

classes.label: Unguided Rocket
classes.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled, but unguided, projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances through the use of a Rocket Engine.

classes.label: Train
classes.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a series of connected Train Cars or Railcars.

classes.label: Act of Volunteering
classes.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by voluntarily undertaking or expressing a willingness to undertake a service.
examples: entering into military service voluntarily
rendering a service voluntarily

classes.label: Act of Assignment
classes.definition: An Act of Declarative Communication in which rights held by one party (the assignor) are transferred to another party (the assignee) with regard to a particular entity as specified by the details of the assignment, which is often prescribed by a contract.

classes.label: Biological Sex
classes.definition: A Quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved.

classes.label: Full Motion Video Camera
classes.definition: A Video Camera that is designed to capture and record images of sufficiently high quality and in rapid enough succession that the resulting video supports smooth playback.

classes.label: Pitch Axis
classes.definition: An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass and is perpendicular both to the direction of the object's motion and to the object's Yaw Axis.

classes.label: Communication System
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable some Act of Communication by means of transmission systems, relay stations, tributary stations, and data terminal equipment, usually capable of interconnection and interoperation to form an integrated whole.

classes.label: Constructed Feature
classes.definition: An Anthropogenic Feature that has been constructed by deliberate human effort.

classes.label: Nickel Cadmium Electric Battery
classes.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a cadmium anode and nickel oxide hydroxide cathode.

classes.label: Act of Repayment
classes.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent (the Debtor) to another Agent (the Creditor) to decrease the amount the Debtor owes to the Creditor from an earlier Act of Loaning.

classes.label: Nadir
classes.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that extends from a given location downward along the local vertical direction pointing in the direction of the apparent Gravitational Force at that location.

classes.label: Sequence Position Ordinality
classes.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is about the position of some entity in some ordered sequence.

classes.label: Equipment Mount
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to support a Material Artifact.

classes.label: Aircraft
classes.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by air travel.

classes.label: Nuclear Radiation Detection Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to detect the presence of nuclear radiation particles.

classes.label: Artifact Model
classes.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a common set of Functions and Qualities to inhere in a set of artifact instances.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Notification Message
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Message that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that describes a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by the recipient.

classes.label: Frequency
classes.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the number of repetitive processes during a particular time period.

classes.label: Increase of Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant has an increase in the level of some Dependent Continuant that it bears.

classes.label: Electrical Power Source
classes.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, and transfer power in the form of electrical energy.

classes.label: Primary Cell Electric Battery
classes.definition: A Electric Battery that is designed for one-time use and not to be recharged.

classes.label: Projectile Launcher
