classes.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict damage or harm by means of launching a high-velocity projectile at a target.

classes.label: Military Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to support a Military Force.

classes.label: Act of Collision
classes.definition: An Act of Location Change involving the movement of one object such that it collides with another object.

classes.label: Helical Antenna
classes.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a conducting wire wound in the form of a helix that is typically mounted over a ground plane with a feed line connected between the bottom of the helix and the ground plane.

classes.label: Branched
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having subdivisions or offshoots.

classes.label: Visible Light Frequency
classes.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 400 and 800 terahertz. Visible light overlaps with near infrared and near ultraviolet.

classes.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Press Release
classes.definition: An Act of Issuing an official statement to one or more members of the media for the purpose of announcing newsworthy information.

classes.label: Hour
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to sixty consecutive Minutes.

classes.label: Shape Quality
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the ratios between dimensions of external features of that bearer.

classes.label: Fuel System
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to pump, manage, and deliver some Portion of Fuel to the Propulsion System and Auxiliary Power Unit of some Vehicle.

classes.label: Motorcycle
classes.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a very small number of passengers (usually 1 or 2) while traveling on two or three tired wheels.

classes.label: International Community
classes.definition: A maximal Group of Geopolitical Organizations engaged in geopolitics with one another. Instances are context-dependent collectives of international actors, such as states, organizations, institutions, or peoples.

classes.label: Straight
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having curves, bends, or angles along its borders.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Barcode
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry one or more geometric shapes that concretize some Prescriptive Information Content Entity. For information on types of barcodes, see:

classes.label: Two Dimensional Extent
classes.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in two dimensions.

classes.label: Loss of Disposition
classes.definition: A Loss of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Disposition.

classes.label: Laser
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to emit light coherently through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

classes.label: Gain of Quality
classes.definition: A Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which an Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Quality.
examples: A person becoming pregnant.

classes.label: Representational Information Content Entity
classes.definition: An Information Content Entity that represents some Entity.
examples: the content of a court transcript represents a courtroom proceeding
the content of a photograph of the Statue of Liberty represents the Statue of Liberty
the content of a video of a sporting event represents that sporting event

classes.label: Fluid Control Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the direction or flow of some fluid.

classes.label: Payload Capacity
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in a Vehicle that is designed to transport Payload, and which is typically characterized by the maximum Weight, Mass, or Volume of Payload that the Vehicle can transport.

classes.label: FM Radio Broadcast Frequency
classes.definition: A Very High Frequency that is between 88 and 108 MHz.

classes.label: Financial Value of Property
classes.definition: Financial Value that inheres in an material entity that is the object of an Act of Ownership.

classes.label: Act of Educational Training Acquisition
classes.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of a curriculum from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with some Educational Organization.

classes.label: Act of Training Instruction
classes.definition: An Act of Training performed by an Agent by imparting knowledge to another Agent.

classes.label: Electric Power Station
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to generate electrical power.

classes.label: Heavy Machine Gun
classes.definition: A Mounted Gun that is designed to fire ammunition greater than .50 caliber or 12.7mm ammunition in quick succession from an ammunition belt, and which typically weighs more than 30lbs.

classes.label: Airport
classes.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed for launching, receiving, and housing Aircraft.

classes.label: Blond
classes.definition: A Color that ranges from nearly white to a light greyish yellow

classes.label: Far Infrared Light Frequency
classes.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 300 gigahertz and 20 terahertz.

classes.label: Geographic Feature
classes.definition: An Environmental Feature that is a natural (i.e. not human made) topographical feature having a (relatively) stable location in some Geospatial Region which can be designated by location-specific data.

classes.label: Patch Receiver
classes.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Patch Antenna to intercept radio signals.

classes.label: Air-Breathing Combustion Engine
classes.definition: A Reaction Engine that functions by drawing a continuous stream of air into and through the Engine where it is compressed, mixed with a Portion of Fuel, ignited, and then expelled as exhaust gas.

classes.label: Portion of Processed Material
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is the output of an Act of Material Artifact Processing.

classes.label: Reflection Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a reflection event in which the Material Artifact causes a change in a wavefront at an interface between the reflecting medium and the transmission medium such that the wavefront returns into the transmission medium.

classes.label: Road Junction
classes.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to exit one Road and enter another.

classes.label: Orientation Observation Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the Orientation of a specified object or class of objects.

classes.label: Decade
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to a period of ten consecutive Years.

classes.label: Petrochemical Refinery
classes.definition: A Refinery that is designed for refining crude oil, intermediate petroleum products, or synthetic petroleum into products of value.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Pressure
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of Force applied perpendicular to a surface per unit area.
examples: pascal, atmosphere, pound-force per square inch

classes.label: Fort
classes.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to support the defense of or solidification of rule over some Geospatial Region and its inhabitants.

classes.label: Electrical Power Storage Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to store electrical power to be released at a later time.

classes.label: Coin
classes.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of a flat, portable, round pieces of metal designed to bear some specified Financial Value.

classes.label: Act of Espionage
classes.definition: An Act of Intelligence Gathering involving the obtaining of information that is considered secret or confidential without the permission of the holder of the information.

classes.label: Cellular Telecommunication Network
classes.definition: A Wireless Telecommunication Network where the last link between the network and the end user is wireless and is distributed over service areas called cells.

classes.label: Submachine Gun
classes.definition: An Long Gun that is designed to be have automatic-fire functionality, fire pistol-caliber ammunition that is magazine-fed, and which is usually smaller than other automatic firearms.

classes.label: Common Stock
classes.definition: Stock that entitles its holder to voting on corporate decisions.

classes.label: Hospital
classes.definition: A Healthcare Facility that is designed to provide patient treatment with specialized staff and equipment.

classes.label: Bridge
classes.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to span physical obstacles without closing the way underneath to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to pass over the obstacles.

classes.label: Measurement Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure one or more features of a specified object or class of objects.

classes.label: Interval Estimate Information Content Entity
classes.definition: An Estimate Information Content Entity that consists of an interval of possible (or probable) values for the measured entity.
altLabels: Interval Estimate Measurement Information Content Entity

classes.label: Commercial Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed for buying and selling goods and services, especially on a large scale.

classes.label: Artifact Model Name
classes.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Material Artifact Model.

classes.label: Long Gun
classes.definition: A Firearm that is designed to have a longer barrel than a Hand Gun and to be fired while braced against the shoulder.

classes.label: Secondary Cell Electric Battery
classes.definition: An Electric Battery that is designed to be recharged.

classes.label: Roll Axis
classes.definition: An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass from the front to the back of the object as defined by the direction of the object's motion.

classes.label: Landfill
classes.definition: A Waste Management Facility that is designed for disposing of waste by burial.

classes.label: Ultra High Frequency
classes.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 300 MHz and 3 GHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 1–0.1 m. Note that the ITU definition of UHF is broader than the definition given by IEEE 521-2002 - IEEE Standard Letter Designations for Radar-Frequency Bands, which sets the frequency range at 300 MHz to 1 GHz.

classes.label: Counter-Clockwise Rotational Motion
classes.definition: A Rotational Motion in which the direction of rotation is toward the left as seen relative to the designated side of the plane of rotation.
examples: the axial rotation of the Earth as seen from above the North Pole

classes.label: Evening
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when the sun sets (approximately 6:00pm) and when people typically retire to sleep (approximately 9:00pm).

classes.label: Low Midrange Frequency
classes.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 250 and 500 Hz.

classes.label: Proper Acceleration
classes.definition: An Acceleration of an object relative to a free-fall, or inertial, observer who is momentarily at rest relative to the object being measured (hence, gravity does not cause Proper Acceleration).

classes.label: Magenta
classes.definition: A Color consisting of red and blue hues.

classes.label: Division of Delimiting Domain
classes.definition: A Geospatial Region that is a fiat division of a Delimiting Domain and not a Delimiting Domain. Instances of this class are not proper Delimiting Domains, but in some cases may have an organization that exercises some control over the region, such as the homeowners' association for a neighborhood.
examples: Flatbush, French Quarter, Western New York, Texas Panhandle, Greater Montreal Area of Quebec, Pacific Northwest, southwest area of Al Anbar Province, Northern Iraq.

classes.label: Private Network Telephone Call
classes.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a network where a closed group of telephones are connected primarily to each other and use a gateway to reach the outside world. Private Network Telephone Calls are typically made within companies or call centers.

classes.label: Reference Time
classes.definition: A Temporal Instant specified as the origin for which other Temporal Regions are measured or identified.

classes.label: Propelling Nozzle
classes.definition: A Nozzle that is used to convert a propulsion Engine into a Jet Engine and functions by using its narrowest part, the throat, to increase Pressure within the Engine by constricting flow, usually until the flow chokes, then expanding the exhaust stream to, or near to, atmospheric pressure, while forming it into a high speed jet to propel the Vehicle.

classes.label: Surface Tension
classes.definition: A Disposition that inheres in a liquid and is realized when the cohesive forces of the molecules in the bearer at the surface are greater than the adhesive forces of the molecules in the surrounding air.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Form Document
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that has one or more Material Copy of a Document Field as parts in which to write or select prescribed content.
examples: A spreadsheet template
A survey

classes.label: Act of Religious Training Instruction
classes.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Religious Organization by imparting knowledge of the tenets and/or practices of a religion to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

classes.label: Scramjet Engine
classes.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses the forward motion of the Engine to compress incoming air at supersonic speeds before adding the fuel and constantly combusting the mixture then expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

classes.label: Radio Interference
classes.definition: A Natural Process in which a radio signal is disrupted, whether unintentionally or as the result of an Act of Radio Jamming, Act of Radio Spoofing, or similar Planned Act.

classes.label: Poison Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a living thing.

classes.label: Precision-Guided Missile
classes.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled and precision-guided projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances.

classes.label: Set of Eyes
classes.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of two or more Eyes that are part of a single Agent.

classes.label: Luminescent Property
classes.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light, but which isn't the result of the bearer being heated. There are a variety of photometric measurements, such as luminous flux/power or luminous intensity, whose units are lumen and candela respectively, which attempt to describe properties associated with the perception of light. These are weighted measurements, typically by the luminosity function, as thus exist on the side of information content. It is a point of further development to add the needed intrinsic properties of radiation that such measurements are about.

classes.label: Loss of Quality
classes.definition: A Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Quality.

classes.label: Act of Residing
classes.definition: An Act of Inhabitancy in which a Person lives in a dwelling permanently or for an extended period of time.

classes.label: Pressurization Control Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Ventilation Control Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the partial pressure of air in some space.

classes.label: Geospatial Polygon
classes.definition: A Geospatial Line String that has at least three vertices where the connecting lines form a closed loop.

classes.label: Stasis of Mission Capability
classes.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity that holds during a temporal interval when a Continuant's capability (or lack thereof) to perform its intended Functions, tasks, or Objectives remains at a relatively constant level.

classes.label: Motion
classes.definition: A Natural Process in which a Continuant changes its Location or Spatial Orientation over some Temporal Interval.

classes.label: Vehicle Frame
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be the main supporting structure of some Vehicle.

classes.label: Portion of Liquid Fuel
classes.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a liquid state.

classes.label: Ultrasonic Frequency
classes.definition: A Sound Frequency that is greater than 20 kHz.

classes.label: Radiation Reflectivity
classes.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to scatter or reflect electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

classes.label: Beverage Antenna
classes.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a horizontal wire one-half to two wavelengths long that is suspended above the ground with one end attached to the receiver feedline and the other grounded and which is typically used in the low and medium frequency radio bands.

classes.label: Spacecraft
classes.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by Spaceflight.

classes.label: Flywheel
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to store rotational energy such that it has a significant moment of inertia which enables it to resist changes in rotational speed.

classes.label: Infrastructure Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in the bearer of a Disposition and has been assigned to an Infrastructure System such that the realization of that Disposition is sometimes part of the functioning of the Infrastructure System. The disposition will typically be a function of an artifact, which is often designed to be part of some Infrastructure system. But not always. In some cases an entity may be repurposed to be an element of some Infrastructure. In those cases it is a capability of that entity that supports the functioning of the system.

classes.label: Violet
classes.definition: A Color that is lower than Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 400 and 450 nanometers.

classes.label: Facsimile Transmission
classes.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which a Document Content Entity is transmitted over a Telephone Network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

classes.label: Act of Entertainment
classes.definition: A Planned Act consisting of any activity which provides a diversion or permits people to amuse themselves.

classes.label: Radio Receiver
classes.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that is designed to extract information from radio waves intercepted by a Radio Antenna by using electronic filters to separate the desired radio frequency signal from other signals, an electronic amplifier to increase the power of the signal, and demodulation to recover the desired information.

classes.label: Sidereal Time Reference System
classes.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is based on Earth's rate of rotation measured relative to one or more fixed Stars (rather than the Sun). Sidereal Time is the angle measured from an observer's meridian along the celestial equator to the Great Circle that passes through the March equinox and both poles. This angle is usually expressed in Hours, Minutes, and Seconds.

classes.label: Act of Violence
classes.definition: A Planned Act of causing harm to oneself or to another through the use of physical or verbal force.

classes.label: Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of electromagnetic radiation.

classes.label: Data Range Interval Estimate Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the absolute difference between the largest value and the smallest value in the set.

classes.label: Portion of Ammunition
classes.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by being projected toward its target at a significant Velocity.

classes.label: Portion of Paper
classes.definition: An Information Medium Artifact that is designed to bear some Information Content Entity by means of pressing together moist fibres of cellulose pulp derived from wood, rags, or grasses, and drying them into flexible sheets.

classes.label: Government Domain
classes.definition: A Delimiting Domain that delimits the authority of a Government to exercise its control within the bounded area.

classes.label: Damaging Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired.

classes.label: Multi-Second Temporal Interval
classes.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Seconds and spans at least one Second. This is a defined class.

classes.label: Full Motion Video Imaging Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce video of entities that is of high enough quality to make the represented motion appear continuous to human viewers.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Information Line
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that consists of a single line or row of some larger Information Bearing Artifact of which it is a part.
examples: a line in a computer file that bears a portion of code for some computer program
a line of data in a database
a line of text in a book

classes.label: Hydraulic Power Source
classes.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, or transmit power by means of pressurized liquid.

classes.label: Act of Data Transformation
classes.definition: An Act of Information Processing in which an algorithm is executed to act upon one or more input Information Content Entities into one or more output Information Content Entities. It is not a requirement that the output Information Content Entity(ies) be qualitatively distinct from the input(s) as a result of an Act of Data Transformation, though doing so is typically the goal of performing this Act. Consider, for example, selecting a column in an Excel spreadsheet then executing the \"Remove Duplicates\" Algorithm on it. The intent is to remove rows in that column containing duplicate content. If no duplicate values are present, the information in the column remains unchanged but an Act of Data Transformation was nonetheless performed.

classes.label: Bond
classes.definition: A Financial Instrument that is designed to secure an Agent's debt for the holders of that debt.

classes.label: Solvent Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in the dissolving of other substances (namely, solutes) without change in the former's chemical structure.

classes.label: Counterfeit Legal Instrument
classes.definition: A Counterfeit Instrument that is designed to be a fake replica of some genuine Legal Instrument.

classes.label: Act of Commissive Communication
classes.definition: An Act of Communication in which an Agent commits themselves to doing, or refraining from doing, some future action. Examples: agreeing, betting, guaranteeing, inviting, offering, promising, swearing, volunteering

classes.label: Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes the extent, dimensions, quantity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard.

classes.label: County
classes.definition: A Government Domain that is part of either a First-Order or Second-Order Administrative Region.

classes.label: Terrorist Training Camp
classes.definition: A Training Camp designed to teach students methods of terrorism.

classes.label: Multi-Minute Temporal Interval
classes.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Minutes and spans at least one Minute. This is a defined class.

classes.label: Midrange Frequency
classes.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 500 Hz and 2 kHz.

classes.label: Reaction Mass
classes.definition: A Material Entity against which a Propulsion System operates in order to produce Acceleration.

classes.label: Communication Relay Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in processes of first receiving and then transmitting information.

classes.label: Hard X-ray Frequency
classes.definition: An X-Ray Frequency that is between 3 and 30 exahertz.

classes.label: Wireless Network Telephone Call
classes.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a network where the telephones are not dependent on a physical connection to the network such that they can continue to operate anywhere within the coverage area.

classes.label: Portion of Gelatinous Propellant
classes.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a gelatinous state.

classes.label: Rocket Launcher
classes.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Unguided Rockets.

classes.label: Electromagnetic Shielding Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an electromagnetic field is blocked by barriers made of conductive or magnetic materials.

classes.label: Language
classes.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a canonical format for communication.

classes.label: Estimate Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of an entity based on partial information about that entity or an appropriately similar entity.

classes.label: Roll Orientation
classes.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Roll Axis.

classes.label: Railway Crossing
classes.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to cross a Railway when traveling along a road or path that is perpendicular to and at the same elevation as the Railway at the point where they overlap.

classes.label: Digital Storage Device
classes.definition: An Information Medium Artifact that is designed to bear some Information Content Entity by means of recording that information in digital (binary) format.
examples: A computer's Hard Disk Drive
A portable USB Drive

classes.label: Organization
classes.definition: A Group of Agents which can be the bearer of roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules. Members of organizations are either Organizations themselves or individual Persons. Members can bear specific Organization Member Roles that are determined in the organization rules. The organization rules also determine how decisions are made on behalf of the Organization by the organization members.

classes.label: Triple Inertial Navigation System
classes.definition: An Inertial Navigation System that is designed to use three redundant computers to continuously calculate via dead reckoning the position, orientation, and velocity of a moving object without the need for external references, in such a way that eliminates the need for a navigator.

classes.label: Phase Angle
classes.definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle between the light incident onto an observed Object and the light reflected from the Object.

classes.label: Social Network
classes.definition: A Group of Agents that are connected in dyadic relations by similar personal or career interests, activities, backgrounds, or real-life connections.

classes.label: Spinning Motion
classes.definition: A Rotational Motion of an Object around an Axis of Rotation that passes through the Object's Center of Mass.

classes.label: Rocket
classes.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to travel through air or space and which obtains Thrust from a Rocket Engine.

classes.label: Color Hue
classes.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect a dominant wavelength of the visible light spectrum, which is typically divided up into 6 to 8 ranges.

classes.label: Navigation System
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable an Agent or Material Artifact to determine the position or direction of some object, usually for the purpose of monitoring or controlling the movement of some Vehicle from one place to another.

classes.label: Denture
classes.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace missing teeth.

classes.label: Blue
classes.definition: A Color that is between Cyan and Violet with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 450 to 490 nanometers.

classes.label: Telephone Call
classes.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which sound is used to communicate over a telephone network to one or more recipients.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

classes.label: Operational Stasis
classes.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact maintains its designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least maintains its primary functions).

classes.label: Radio Antenna
classes.definition: A Bidirectional Transducer that is designed to convert electric power into radio waves, and radio waves into electric power.

classes.label: Fatigability
classes.definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer loses strength and tires quickly.

classes.label: Gain of Role
classes.definition: A Gain of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant becomes bearer of some Role. This class should be used to demarcate the start of the temporal interval (through the occupies temporal region property) that the Entity bears the Role.

classes.label: Geospatial Error Region
classes.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary that bounds some Geospatial Region according to probability estimations for locating some object within it.

classes.label: Act of Artifact Assembly
classes.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein a new Material Artifact are created by fitting component parts together. Many Acts of Manufacturing and Construction involve one or more Acts of Artifact Assembly, but Acts of Artifact Assembly can also occur in isolation from these activities.
examples: putting together a piece of furniture purchased from Ikea

classes.label: Anthropogenic Feature
classes.definition: An Environmental Feature that is related to or is the result of the influence of human beings on the environment.

classes.label: Railcar
classes.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a single self-propelled Vehicle that is not a Train, is designed to transport passengers, and which may also be designed to connect to other Railcars to form a Train. In American-English, the term 'Railcar' is often used in a broader sense that is interchangeable with 'Railroad Car'.

classes.label: Protruding
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a part of an object in virtue of the part extending out above or beyond the surface of the object.

classes.label: Structural Support Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact providing physical support to another object.

classes.label: Trail
classes.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable transport through rough country, such as a forest or moor.

classes.label: Size Quality
classes.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one or more dimensions.

classes.label: Delimiting Domain
classes.definition: A Geospatial Region that delimits the authority of an Organization to exercise its control within the bounded area.

classes.label: Night
classes.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when people typically retire to sleep (approximately 9:00pm) and when the sun dawns (approximately 6:00am).

classes.label: Priority Scale
classes.definition: A Reference System that is designed to be used to rank or identify the importance of entities of the specified type.

classes.label: Multi-Year Temporal Interval
classes.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Years and spans at least one Year. This is a defined class.

classes.label: Optical Lens
classes.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to focus or disperse a beam of light entering the lens by means of refraction.

classes.label: High Frequency
classes.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 MHz. The corresponding Wavelength range is 100–10 m

classes.label: Retail Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of selling goods or merchandise in small or individual lots for direct consumption by persons or organizations.

classes.label: Lifting Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to lift some object.

classes.label: Female Sex
classes.definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual that only produces gametes that can be fertilized by male gametes.

classes.label: Stasis of Artifact Operationality
classes.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact's designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least its primary functions) or the realizations of those functions remain unchanged.

classes.label: Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: An Increase of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Specifically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

classes.label: Funeral
classes.definition: An Act of Ceremony in which the Life of a Person who has died is celebrated, sanctified, or remembered.

classes.label: Periscope
classes.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to enable observation of an object that is located over, around, or through another object, obstacle, or condition that prevents direct line-of-sight observation from the observer's current position.

classes.label: Medium Machine Gun
classes.definition: A Mounted Gun that is designed to fire full-power rifle Cartridges (less than .50 caliber or 12.7mm) in quick succession from an ammunition belt, and which typically weighs 22-30 lbs.

classes.label: Signal Processing Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in the process of transferring or processing information contained in signals.

classes.label: Delta-v
classes.definition: A Process Profile that is the total change in Velocity of an object's Motion. Delta-v is not equivalent to and should not be confused with Acceleration, which is the rate of change of Velocity.

classes.label: Opaque
classes.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's incapacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

classes.label: Physically Powered Engine
classes.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert potential or kinetic energy into mechanical energy.

classes.label: Solar Panel System
classes.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of one or more Solar Panels, a power inverter, electrical wiring between the components, a mounting and support structure, and may also include a battery and/or a solar tracking system and is the bearer of functions realized in processes of deriving, transferring, and storing electrical energy derived from light energy.

classes.label: Dish Receiver
classes.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Parabolic (or Dish) Antenna to intercept radio signals.

classes.label: Process Requirement
classes.definition: A Process Regulation that requires some Process.

classes.label: Yellow
classes.definition: A Color that is between Orange and Green with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 560 to 590 nanometers.

classes.label: Act of Employment by an Organization
classes.definition: An Act of Employment wherein an Organization assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

classes.label: Longitudinal Wave Profile
classes.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the displacement of participating particles is parallel to the direction of the Wave Process' propogation such that the particles alternate between participating in processes of compression and rarefaction as they participate in individual Wave Processes.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Journal Article
classes.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry a specific brief composition on a specific topic as part of a Journal Issue.

classes.label: Alkaline Electric Battery
classes.definition: A Primary Cell Electric Battery that has a Zinc anode and Manganese (IV) oxide cathode.

classes.label: Rhombic Antenna
classes.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of one to three parallel wires suspended above the ground by poles or towers at each vertex in a rhombic shape with each of the four sides being the same length (typically at least one wavelength or longer).

classes.label: Brilliance Frequency
classes.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 6 and 20 kHz.

classes.label: Act of Possession
classes.definition: A Planned Act in which an agent intentionally exercises control towards a thing. In all cases, to possess something, an agent must have an intention to possess it.

classes.label: Crushing Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of significant pressure.

classes.label: Neutralization Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an acid and a base react quantitatively with each other.

classes.label: Military Time Zone Identifier
classes.definition: A Time Zone Identifier that designates a spatial region where the local time is calculated according to the specified offset from Zulu time, which has no offset from Coordinated Universal Time.

classes.label: Act of Suicide
classes.definition: An Act of Violence in which some Agent intentionally and voluntarily causes their own death.

classes.label: Birth
classes.definition: A Process of bringing forth offspring.

classes.label: Initialism
classes.definition: An Abbreviated Name that consists of the initial letters of some words (or syllables) in a Designative Name, and in which each letter is pronounced separately.
examples: USA, CPU, BBC

classes.label: Group of Organizations
classes.definition: A Group of Agents that has only Organizations as member parts.

classes.label: Radio Communication Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of radio waves.

classes.label: Sensor Function
classes.definition: A Function that is realized in processes wherein an attribute of its bearer is a proxy for some aspect of its sensing environment. A proxy in the sense used here is a stand-in used in place of something else, often because the original is unavailable or not directly accessible.

classes.label: Actuator
classes.definition: A Transducer that is designed to convert some control signal into mechanical motion.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Document Field
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Entity that is a part of some document into which carriers of prescribed information can be written or selected.

classes.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Article
classes.definition: An Act of Issuing a non-fictional essay, especially one included with others in a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

classes.label: Under Active Control
classes.definition: An Active Stasis during which a Material Artifact participates in an Act of Artifact Employment.

classes.label: Telecommunication Endpoint
classes.definition: A Telecommunication Network Node that connects a Telecommunication Terminal to a Telecommunication Network. A Telecommunication Terminal is an end user device such as a Telephone, fax machine, or Computer.

classes.label: Artificial Eye
classes.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing eye.

classes.label: Cabin Pressurization Control System
classes.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to control the process in which conditioned air is pumped into the Cabin of some Aircraft or Spacecraft in order to create a safe and comfortable environment for passengers and crew flying at high altitudes.

classes.label: Interior Lighting System
classes.definition: A Lighting System that is designed to emit light within the interior of some area.

classes.label: Act of Intelligence Gathering
classes.definition: A Planned Act of producing and/or gathering information by a government or other Organization to guide decisions and actions by answering questions or obtaining advance warning of events and movements deemed to be important or otherwise relevant.

classes.label: Propulsion Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the bearer of the function creates force leading to an entity's movement.

classes.label: Fuel Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which a Portion of Fuel is reacted with other substances in order to release chemical or nuclear energy to be used for heat or for work.

classes.label: Revolver
classes.definition: A Hand Gun having a number of firing chambers in a revolving cylinder, where each chamber in the cylinder can be loaded with a single Cartridge.

classes.label: Insecticide Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process that causes harm to, or the death of, an insect.

classes.label: Reliability Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which an entity can consistently produce an outcome. Note, the term 'accuracy' is avoided due to its ambiguity between: correctness-of-performance ('Reliability Measurement Information Content Entity'), correctness-of-information (see: 'Veracity Measurement Information Content Entity'), and adherance-to-expectations (see: 'Deviation Measurement Information Content Entity').

classes.label: Nuclear Storage Depot
classes.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store nuclear material.

classes.label: Port
classes.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed to contain harbors for docking Watercraft and for transfering people or cargo to and from land.

classes.label: Portion of Atmosphere
classes.definition: A fiat object part of the layer of gas or layers of gases that envelop a natural satellite.

classes.label: Act of Identifying
classes.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by asserting who or what a particular person or thing is.

classes.label: Person
classes.definition: An Animal that is a member of the species Homo sapiens.

classes.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Documentary
classes.definition: An Act of Issuing information that provides a factual record or report.

classes.label: Public Address System
classes.definition: A Communication System that is designed to allow a Person to speak to a large audience.

classes.label: Act of Vocational Training Instruction
classes.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with a Vocational School, Technical School, Trade Organization, or Industry Educational Program Provider by imparting skills required for a specific occupation in industry, agriculture or trade to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

classes.label: Act of Propaganda
classes.definition: An Act of Deceptive Communication Propaganda intended to influence the attitude of a mass audience toward some cause or position by presenting facts selectively (thus possibly lying by omission) or by using loaded messages to produce an emotional rather than rational response to the information presented.

classes.label: Act of Warning
classes.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by indicating a possible or impending danger, problem, or other unpleasant situation.

classes.label: Howitzer
classes.definition: A Cannon that is designed to have a relatively short barrel and to use relatively small propellant charges to propel projectiles in relatively high trajectories with a steep angle of descent.

classes.label: Wired Communication Relay Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Communication Relay Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to first receive and then transmit information by means of wires from one Material Artifact to another for the purpose of communiction.

classes.label: Act of Murder
classes.definition: An Act of Homicide with malice aforethought.

classes.label: Infrasonic Frequency
classes.definition: A Sound Frequency that is below 20 Hz.

classes.label: Nominal Speed Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains a speed that does not exceed some specified tolerance of that Material Artifact.

classes.label: Carrier Air Wing
classes.definition: A Military Force that is trained and equipped to conduct air operations while embarked on an aircraft carrier.

classes.label: Red
classes.definition: A Color that is above Orange with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 635 to 700 nanometers.

classes.label: Stock
classes.definition: A Financial Instrument that entitles holders to an ownership interest (equity) in the specified Incorporated Organization.

classes.label: Vibration Motion
classes.definition: A Motion wherein some participant repetitively deviates from a central location to two surrounding locations.

classes.label: Flat
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border without a significant deviation.

classes.label: Emulsifier Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which two or more liquids that are normally immiscible are mixed.

classes.label: Hydraulic Valve
classes.definition: A Valve that is designed to regulate, direct, or control the flow of a liquid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing various passageways.

classes.label: Refinery
classes.definition: A Factory that is designed for refining raw materials into products of value.

classes.label: Crew
classes.definition: A Group of Persons that bear Roles realized by the operation of the specified Vehicle.

classes.label: Revolving Motion
classes.definition: A Rotational Motion of an Object around an Axis of Rotation that is located externally to the Site occupied by the Object.

classes.label: Waveform
classes.definition: A Wave Process Profile that is the shape of the Wave Cycles of the Wave Process when depicted in a visual graph.

classes.label: Maintenance Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to be used to perform actions to maintain or improve the state of some property or equipment.

classes.label: Round Shot
classes.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a solid projectile without explosive charge and to be fired from a cannon.

classes.label: Damaged Stasis
classes.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has suffered impairment (i.e., a decrease or loss) due to a previous action or event such that the Independent Continuant is now of lesser value, usefulness, or functionality. This class can be used to instantiate instances that might otherwise be treated by defined classes such as Damaged Vehicle or Wounded Person; the Independent Continuant and Quality or Realizable Entity are participants of the stasis which can in turn be related to the temporal interval via the occupies temporal region property.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Length
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of one-dimensional regions or Geospatial Regions.
examples: foot, meter, kilometer, mile

classes.label: Radiation Absorptivity
classes.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to absorb electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

classes.label: Bus
classes.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a large number of people and to travel on six or more tired wheels.

classes.label: Perimeter
classes.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the extent of a boundary which encloses the bearer.

classes.label: Three Dimensional Extent
classes.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in three dimensions.

classes.label: Financial Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to support the management of money.

classes.label: Pitch Orientation
classes.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Pitch Axis.

classes.label: Military Headquarters Facility
classes.definition: A Military Facility that is designed for military administration and coordination.

classes.label: Material Copy of a Document
classes.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity in a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams in the form of physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processor file.

classes.label: Wetting Agent Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Surfactant Artifact Function that is realized in a process that reduces the water repellent tendency of a substance thereby allowing it to become wet.

classes.label: Patch Antenna
classes.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists of a flat rectangular sheet (or patch) of metal mounted over a larger sheet of metal called a ground plane which is typically contained inside a plastic radome for protection and is small enough that it can be mounted on a flat surface.

classes.label: Service Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process of providing intangible goods to consumers.

classes.label: Civil Organization
classes.definition: An Organization that is not commercial or military and is the bearer of a Civilian Role.

classes.label: Position Observation Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the position of a specified object or class of objects.

classes.label: Dimension Specification
classes.definition: An Quality Specification that prescribes some Size Quality.

classes.label: Loss of Function
classes.definition: A Loss of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Function.

classes.label: Observation Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about a specified object or class of objects.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Mass Flow Rate
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit of Flow that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate at which the Mass of a substance passes per unit time.
examples: kilogram per second, slug per second, pound per second

classes.label: Sewage Treatment Facility
classes.definition: A Waste Management Facility that is designed for removing contaminants from wastewater, especially sewage.

classes.label: Lot Number
classes.definition: A Code Identifier that designates a particular quantity or lot of material from a single manufacturer.

classes.label: Covering Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an entity is covered.

classes.label: Aircraft Manufacturing Facility
classes.definition: A Factory that is designed to manufacture Aircraft.

classes.label: Paramilitary Force
classes.definition: An Armed Force whose organizational structure, training, subculture, and (often) function are similar to those of a professional Military, and which is not included as part of a Government's formal Armed Forces.

classes.label: Article of Clothing
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to cover some portion of a body.

classes.label: Legal System Act
classes.definition: A Planned Act performed by an Agent that realizes their role within the context of a legal system of some jurisdiction.

classes.label: Waste Management Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed for managing waste for some portion of the waste's existence.

classes.label: Gimbal
classes.definition: An Equipment Mount that consists of a pivoted support that allows a Material Artifact to Rotate about one or more Axes.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Volume
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of sites or three-dimensional spatial regions.
examples: cubic feet, cubic meter, quart, liter

classes.label: Yaw Orientation
classes.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Yaw Axis.

classes.label: Tank
classes.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to carry heavy firepower, have a powerful Engine, and travel on one or more continuous tracks such that it is suitable for front-line combat and can provide operational maneuverability as well as tactical offensive and defensive capabilities. Tank firepower is normally provided by a large-caliber main gun mounted in a rotating turret, which is supported by secondary machine guns. A tank's heavy armour and all-terrain mobility provide protection for both the tank and its crew, allowing it to perform all primary tasks of the armoured troops on the battlefield.

classes.label: Radio Transceiver
classes.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device composed of both a Radio Transmitter and a Radio Receiver that share common circuitry or a single housing.

classes.label: Lead Acid Electric Battery
classes.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a lead anode and lead oxide cathode.

classes.label: Decrease of Generically Dependent Continuant
classes.definition: A Decrease of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in the level of a Generically Dependent Continuant that it bears. For the most part Generically Dependent Continuants do not inhere in their bearers over some continuous scale. The primary exception is religion and this class allows annotation of those cases where an Agent is described as becoming less religious. Other cases would include the decrease of an organization's bearing of some objective.

classes.label: Bearing Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which the Material Artifact constrains relative motion to only the desired motion, and reduces friction between moving parts.

classes.label: Process Regulation
classes.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes an Process as required, prohibited, or permitted, and is the output of an Process which realizes some Authority Role. Although regulations often regulate processes which involve agents--as the regulating or regulated participant--it is unclear how causally active an agents need to be in those regulated processes. For example, it is not clear how causally active a human agent is in the process of a traffic light regulating the motion of a self-driving vehicle.

classes.label: Act of Renting
classes.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Renter) as a payment to acquire temporary possession or use of a good or property that is owned or controlled by another Agent (the Seller).

classes.label: Land Transportation Artifact
classes.definition: A Transportation Artifact that facilitates the movement of Agents and Vehicles via land

classes.label: Social Act
classes.definition: A Planned Act having an objective that affects, is performed by, or is performed on behalf of, a community or group of Persons.

classes.label: Temporal Reference System
classes.definition: A Reference System that describes a set of standards for measuring time as well as understanding the context of and organizing temporal data.

classes.label: Education Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of transmiting accumulated knowledge skills and values from one generation to another.

classes.label: Telemetry Process
classes.definition: A Mechanical Process that is highly automated and in which measurements are made or other data is collected and transmitted to receiving equipment to facilitate the monitoring of environmental conditions or equipment parameters at a remote or inaccessible location.
examples: using a GPS tag to track a shark's migratory pattern
using a portable cardiac monitor to remotely collect data on a patient's heart activity (biotelemetry)

classes.label: Legal Name
classes.definition: A Proper Name that is an official name for the designated entity as determined by a Government or court of law.

classes.label: Extreme Ultraviolet Light Frequency
classes.definition: An Ultraviolet Light Frequency that is between 3 and 30 petahertz.

classes.label: Rosy
classes.definition: A Color consisting of red hue and yellow hue and high brightness.

classes.label: Act of Purchasing
classes.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Purchaser) to acquire a good or service from another Agent (the Provider).

classes.label: Government
classes.definition: An Organization that is the highest legitimate authority delimited by some Delimiting Domain and that exercises executive, legislative, or judicial authority in that Domain.

classes.label: Act of Ownership
classes.definition: An Act of Possession that includes an agent having certain rights and duties over the property owned. The relation between the owner and property may be private, collective, or common and the property may be objects, land, real estate, or intellectual property.

classes.label: Infrared Light Frequency
classes.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 300 gigahertz and 430 tetrahertz.

classes.label: Timbre
classes.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the variation, spectrum, or envelope of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from dull or dark to bright.

classes.label: Act of Walking
classes.definition: An Act of Travel that proceeds by foot.

classes.label: Calendar Date Identifier
classes.definition: A Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a combination of Day, Week, Month, or Year Identifiers formatted according to an implementation of a Calendar System.

classes.label: Portion of Geosphere
classes.definition: A fiat object part that is composed of one or more portions of the atmosphere, cryosphere, hydrosphere, or lithosphere

classes.label: Infantry Fighting Vehicle
classes.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to carry infantry into battle and to provide fire support for them. Infantry Fighting Vehicles (IFVs) are differentiated from Armored Personnel Carriers (APCs) because they are designed to give direct fire support to the dismounted infantry and so usually have significantly enhanced armament. IFVs also often have improved armour and firing ports (allowing the infantry to fire personal weapons while mounted).

classes.label: Circuit Breaker
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to protect an electrical circuit from damage caused by excess current from an overload or short circuit.

classes.label: Biological Depot
classes.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store biological agents.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Impulse
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the integral of a Force applied to a portion of matter over a temporal interval.
examples: N s, dyne second

classes.label: Legal Instrument
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed as a formally executed written document that can be formally attributed to its author, records and formally expresses a legally enforceable act, process, or contractual duty, obligation, or right, and therefore evidences that act, process, or agreement.

classes.label: Behavior
classes.definition: An Act in which an Independent Continuant participates as an Agent in response to external or internal stimuli and following some pattern which is dependent upon some combination of that Independent Continuant's internal state and external conditions.

classes.label: Three-Dimensional Position
classes.definition: A Three-Dimensional Spatial Region that encompasses the (minimal) spatial region in which some object is located at a particular time. For an object in motion, its Three-Dimensional Position is part of its Three-Dimensional Path.

classes.label: Grey
classes.definition: A Color between white and black colors.

classes.label: Thermal Control Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact increasing, decreasing, or maintaining the temperature of itself, a part of itself, or another object.

classes.label: Cartesian Coordinate System
classes.definition: A Spatial Reference System that identifies each point in a spatial region of n-dimensions using an ordered n-tuple of numerical coordinates that are the signed (i.e. positive or negative) distances measured in the same unit of length from the zero point where the fixed perpendicular Coordinate System Axes meet.

classes.label: Greenwich Mean Time Zone Identifier
classes.definition: A Time Zone Identifier that designates a spatial region where the local time is calculated according to the specified offset from Greenwich Mean Time. Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) is the mean solar time at the Royal Observatory in Greenwich, London and has been superseded by Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

classes.label: Speed Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which its bearer has some speed.

classes.label: Vermilion
classes.definition: A Color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.

classes.label: Freight Train Car
classes.definition: A Train Car that is designed to transport cargo.

classes.label: Increase of Disposition
classes.definition: An Increase of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Disposition that it bears.

classes.label: Measurement Unit of Time
classes.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of temporal regions.
examples: second, minute, hour, day

classes.label: School
classes.definition: An Education Facility that is designed to provide learning space and environments for teaching of students under the direction of teachers.

classes.label: Act of Manufacturing
classes.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are mass produced in a Facility for the purpose of being sold or distributed to consumers. An Act of Manufacturing typically involves the mass production of goods.

classes.label: Three Dimensional Shape
classes.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres only in a three dimensional entity.

classes.label: Healing Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which health is restored to an unbalanced, diseased, or damaged organism.

classes.label: Gas Processing Facility
classes.definition: A Refinery that is designed for refining natural gas into products of value.

classes.label: Male Sex
classes.definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual whose sex organs contain only male gametes.

classes.label: Interval Measurement Information Content Entity
classes.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that places a Quality of an Entity onto some interval scale having no true zero value. Four of the subtypes of measurements used here (Interval, Nominal, Ordinal, and Ratio) were originally defined by S.S. Stevens in the article "On the Theory of Scales of Measurement" in Science, Vol. 103 No. 2684 on June 7, 1946. For an introductory article with links to additional content including criticisms and alternate classifications of measurements see
examples: The sentence "The temperature reached -27 degrees Fahrenheit on January 20, 1985 in Chicago, IL." is the carrier of an interval measurement as 0 degrees on the Fahrenheit scale does not describe absolute zero.

classes.label: Maximum Speed Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Material Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains the highest speed at which that Material Artifact is designed to operate.

classes.label: Powering Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to supply power to some Material Artifact.

classes.label: One Dimensional Extent
classes.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one dimension. Subclasses of one dimensional extent are included for usability. It is doubtful any of them can be objectively distinguished (on the side of the bearing entity) without some reference to external properties such as orientation and perspective.

classes.label: Motion Observation Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the Motion of a specified object or class of objects.

classes.label: Rectangular
classes.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of having four sides and four 90 degree angles.

classes.label: Machine Bearing
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to constrain relative motion to only desired motion and reduces friction between moving parts.

classes.label: Electromagnetic Induction Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact that is used to produce electromotive force across an electrical conductor due to its dynamic interaction with a magnetic field.

classes.label: Fertilizer Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Enhancing Artifact Function that is realized in processes of supplying soilds or plant tissues with one or more plant nutrients essential to growth.

classes.label: Bow
classes.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch Arrows.

classes.label: Act of Declarative Communication
classes.definition: An Act of Communication that changes the reality in accord with the content of the declaration. Examples: Baptism, Sentencing a person to imprisonment, Pronouncing a couple husband and wife, Declaring war

classes.label: Washing Facility
classes.definition: A Facility that is designed to wash personnel or equipment.

classes.label: Torque
classes.definition: A Force that is applied to an object in a direction that would tend to cause the object to rotate around an Axis of Rotation and is the rate of change of an object's Angular Momentum.

classes.label: Gold Color
classes.definition: A Color that resembles a yellow-orange Hue with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

classes.label: Hospitality Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of accommodation food and beverage meeting and events gaming entertainment and recreation tourism services and visitor information.

classes.label: Agent Capability
classes.definition: A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act.

classes.label: Farm
classes.definition: An Agricultural Facility that is designed to produce food and other crops.

classes.label: Medical Artifact
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed for diagnosing, treating, or preventing disease, disability, or death.

classes.label: Electronic Cash
classes.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of Bytes.

classes.label: Fire Station
classes.definition: A Public Safety Facility that is designed for the storage of firefighting apparatus.

classes.label: Opacity
classes.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer instead of reflecting, scattering, or absorbing electromangentic radiation of that frequency. Note that it is important to specify the frequency of electromagnetic radiation when representing a bearer's Opacity since a bearer may be Opaque with respect to electromagnetic radiation of one frequency, but be transparent with respect to electromagnetic radiation of another frequency. Unless otherwise stated, statements about a bearer's Opacity are assumed to be about electromagnetic radiation with a frequency in the visible spectrum.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

classes.label: Filter Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process where entities of a specific type or which have specified properties enter it or pass through it. Although its basic function remains the same, a Filter can be used in 2 different ways: (1) to allow only the desired entities to pass through (e.g. removing dirt from engine oil); or (2) to allow everything except the desired entities to pass through (e.g. panning for gold).

classes.label: Center of Mass
classes.definition: A Fiat Point that is where the weighted position vectors of the distributed Mass of a Material Entity relative to this point sum to zero.

classes.label: Media Content Entity
classes.definition: An information content entity presented in a canonical media format. By 'canonical', it is intended that the media format is of a commonly recognized format, such as mass media formats such as books, magazines, and journals, as well as digital media forms (e.g. ebooks), to include, too, file types, such as those recognized by the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA)'s Media Types standard [RFC2046].

classes.label: Certificate
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity that attests to certain demonstrated characteristics of an Object, Person, or Organization.

classes.label: Academic Degree
classes.definition: A Certificate issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement.

classes.label: Image
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity represents some entity owing to a visual isomorphism between the carrying artifact and the entity.

classes.label: Chart
classes.definition: An Image that is prescribed by some canonical visual format.

classes.label: Database
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity that is designed to be rapidly searchable and retrievable.

classes.label: List
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity whose parts are the subject of some Sequence Position Ordinality.

classes.label: Code List
classes.definition: A List whose parts are Code Identifiers.

classes.label: Video
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity that contains a sequence of representations that are presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity.

classes.label: Message
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity that is relatively brief and designed to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

classes.label: Warning Message
classes.definition: A Message that describes a possible or impending threat.

classes.label: Email Message
classes.definition: A Message that is transmitted to the recipient's Email Box.

classes.label: Notification Message
classes.definition: A Message that describes a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by the recipient.

classes.label: Barcode
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity that represents one or more geometric shapes that have, as part, some Prescriptive Information Content Entity. For information on types of barcodes, see:

classes.label: Information Line
classes.definition: A Media Content entity consisting of a single line or row in some Document Content entity of which it is a part.
examples: a line in a computer file that bears a portion of code for some computer program
a line of data in a database
a line of text in a book

classes.label: Document Field Content
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity that is a part of some document content entity, and which prescribes the eliciation of information to be written or selected within the document content entity.

classes.label: Document Content Entity
classes.definition: A Media Content Entity that consists of a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams that are intended to be carried by physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processor file.

classes.label: Book
classes.definition: A Document Content Entity that canonically appears as ink on paper or parchment, or other materials fastened together to hinge at one side.

classes.label: Transcript
classes.definition: A Document Content Entity that was originally recorded in a different medium.

classes.label: Spreadsheet
classes.definition: A Document Content Entity that canonically appears as a interactive, tabular form.

classes.label: Report
classes.definition: A Document Content entity that conveys an account of some event, situation, or the result of some observation or inquiry.

classes.label: Form Document
classes.definition: A Document Content Entity that has Document Field Contents as parts.

classes.label: Journal Article
classes.definition: A Document Content Entity that is part of a Journal Issue.

classes.label: Explosive Mine
classes.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be concealed and to detonate as its target passes near it. Being (relatively) stationary is a common but not necessary feature of explosive mines.

classes.label: Explosive Naval Mine
classes.definition: An Explosive Mine that is designed to be concealed on or under water.

classes.label: Display Instrument
classes.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to bear an Image Display Artifact Function.

classes.label: Image Display Artifact Function
classes.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to display an Image.

classes.label: Email Address
classes.definition: A Designative Name created in order to identify some Email Box as the destination of an email message for the purpose of Email Messaging.

classes.label: Act of Employment
classes.definition: An Act of Association wherein an Agent assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

classes.label: Sensor Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being used in a process wherein an attribute of its bearer acts as a proxy for some aspect of its sensing environment.

classes.label: Sensor Platform Role
classes.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being used to support or convey a Sensor during its deployment and functioning.

classes.label: Sensing Process
classes.definition: A Process that realizes a Sensor Function or Sensor Role.

classes.label: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact
classes.definition: An Act of Communication in which technology is used to create a new copy of the Information Content Entity in the recipient.

classes.label: Act of Publishing
classes.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving the preparation and public issuance of information.

classes.label: Act of Issuing
classes.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving sending forth, distributing, or putting into circulation some Information Content Entity.

classes.label: Communication Transmission Artifact Function
classes.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process of sending information.

classes.label: Act of Refrain
classes.definition: A Planned Act in which some Agent avoids or stops themselves from participating in some Planned Act.

classes.label: Act of Censuring
classes.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing strong disapproval or criticism.

properties.label: has realization
properties.definition: b has realization c =Def c realizes b
examples: As for realizes

properties.label: realizes
properties.definition: (Elucidation) realizes is a relation between a process b and realizable entity c such that c inheres in some d & for all t, if b has participant d then c exists & the type instantiated by b is correlated with the type instantiated by c Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>
examples: A balding process realizes a disposition to go bald; a studying process realizes a student role; a process of pumping blood realizes the pumping function of a heart

properties.label: participates in
