properties.definition: (Elucidation) participates in holds between some b that is either a specifically dependent continuant or generically dependent continuant or independent continuant that is not a spatial region & some process p such that b participates in p some way Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: has participant
properties.definition: p has participant c =Def c participates in p Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: is concretized by
properties.definition: c is concretized by b =Def b concretizes c Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: concretizes
properties.definition: b concretizes c =Def b is a process or a specifically dependent continuant & c is a generically dependent continuant & there is some time t such that c is the pattern or content which b shares at t with actual or potential copies Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: preceded by
properties.definition: b preceded by c =Def b precedes c
examples: The temporal region occupied by the second half of the match is preceded by the temporal region occupied by the first half of the match

properties.label: precedes
properties.definition: (Elucidation) precedes is a relation between occurrents o, o' such that if t is the temporal extent of o & t' is the temporal extent of o' then either the last instant of o is before the first instant of o' or the last instant of o is the first instant of o' & neither o nor o' are temporal instants Each temporal region is its own temporal extent. The temporal extent of a spatiotemporal region is the temporal region it temporally projects onto. The temporal extent of a process or process boundary that occupies temporal region t is t.
examples: The temporal region occupied by Mary's birth precedes the temporal region occupied by Mary's death.

properties.label: occurs in
properties.definition: b occurs in c =Def b is a process or a process boundary & c is a material entity or site & there exists a spatiotemporal region r & b occupies spatiotemporal region r & for all time t, if b exists at t then c exists at t & there exist spatial regions s and s' where b spatially projects onto s at t & c occupies spatial region s' at t & s is a continuant part of s' at t
examples: A process of digestion occurs in the interior of an organism; a process of loading artillery rounds into a tank cannon occurs in the interior of the tank

properties.label: generically depends on
properties.definition: b generically depends on c =Def b is a generically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & at some time t there inheres in c a specifically dependent continuant which concretizes b at t Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: is carrier of
properties.definition: b is carrier of c =Def there is some time t such that c generically depends on b at t Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: exists at
properties.definition: (Elucidation) exists at is a relation between a particular and some temporal region at which the particular exists
examples: First World War exists at 1914-1916; Mexico exists at January 1, 2000

properties.label: has member part
properties.definition: b has member part c =Def c member part of b Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: has occurrent part
properties.definition: b has occurrent part c =Def c occurrent part of b
examples: Mary's life has occurrent part Mary's 5th birthday

properties.label: has temporal part
properties.definition: b has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b
examples: Your life has temporal part the first year of your life

properties.label: location of
properties.definition: b location of c =Def c located in b Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: material basis of
properties.definition: b material basis of c =Def c has material basis b Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: member part of
properties.definition: b member part of c =Def b is an object & c is a material entity & there is some time t such that b continuant part of c at t & there is a mutually exhaustive and pairwise disjoint partition of c into objects x1, ..., xn (for some n ≠ 1) with b = xi (for some 1 <= i <= n) Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: occurrent part of
properties.definition: (Elucidation) occurrent part of is a relation between occurrents b and c when b is part of c
examples: Mary's 5th birthday is an occurrent part of Mary's life; the first set of the tennis match is an occurrent part of the tennis match

properties.label: temporal part of
properties.definition: b temporal part of c =Def b occurrent part of c & (b and c are temporal regions) or (b and c are spatiotemporal regions & b temporally projects onto an occurrent part of the temporal region that c temporally projects onto) or (b and c are processes or process boundaries & b occupies a temporal region that is an occurrent part of the temporal region that c occupies)
examples: Your heart beating from 4pm to 5pm today is a temporal part of the process of your heart beating; the 4th year of your life is a temporal part of your life, as is the process boundary which separates the 3rd and 4th years of your life; the first quarter of a game of football is a temporal part of the whole game

properties.label: temporally projects onto
properties.definition: (Elucidation) temporally projects onto is a relation between a spatiotemporal region s and some temporal region which is the temporal extent of s
examples: The world line of a particle temporally projects onto the temporal region extending from the beginning to the end of the existence of the particle

properties.label: located in
properties.definition: b located in c =Def b is an independent continuant & c is an independent & neither is a spatial region & there is some time t such that the spatial region which b occupies at t is continuant part of the spatial region which c occupies at t Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: continuant part of
properties.definition: b continuant part of c =Def b and c are continuants & there is some time t such that b and c exist at t & b continuant part of c at t Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>
examples: Milk teeth continuant part of human; surgically removed tumour continuant part of organism

properties.label: has continuant part
properties.definition: b has continuant part c =Def c continuant part of b Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: environs
properties.definition: b environs c =Def c occurs in b
examples: Mouth environs process of mastication; city environs traffic

properties.label: history of
properties.definition: (Elucidation) history of is a relation between history b and material entity c such that b is the unique history of c
examples: This life is the history of this organism

properties.label: has history
properties.definition: b has history c =Def c history of b
examples: This organism has history this life

properties.label: specifically depended on by
properties.definition: b specifically depended on by c =Def c specifically depends on b
examples: Coloured object specifically depended on by colour

properties.label: specifically depends on
properties.definition: (Elucidation) specifically depends on is a relation between a specifically dependent continuant b and specifically dependent continuant or independent continuant that is not a spatial region c such that b and c share no parts in common & b is of a nature such that at all times t it cannot exist unless c exists & b is not a boundary of c The analogue of specifically depends on for occurrents is has participant.
examples: A shape specifically depends on the shaped object; hue, saturation and brightness of a colour sample specifically depends on each other

properties.label: bearer of
properties.definition: b bearer of c =Def c inheres in b
examples: A patch of ink is the bearer of a colour quality; an organism is the bearer of a temperature quality

properties.label: inheres in
properties.definition: b inheres in c =Def b is a specifically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & b specifically depends on c
examples: A shape inheres in a shaped object; a mass inheres in a material entity

properties.label: occupies temporal region
properties.definition: p occupies temporal region t =Def p is a process or process boundary & the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t
examples: The Second World War occupies the temporal region September 1, 1939 - September 2, 1945

properties.label: occupies spatiotemporal region
properties.definition: (Elucidation) occupies spatiotemporal region is a relation between a process or process boundary p and the spatiotemporal region s which is its spatiotemporal extent
examples: A particle emitted by a nuclear reactor occupies the spatiotemporal region which is its trajectory

properties.label: occupies spatial region
properties.definition: b occupies spatial region r =Def b is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & r is a spatial region & there is some time t such that every continuant part of b occupies some continuant part of r at t and no continuant part of b occupies any spatial region that is not a continuant part of r at t Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: spatially projects onto
properties.definition: (Elucidation) spatially projects onto is a relation between some spatiotemporal region b and spatial region c such that at some time t, c is the spatial extent of b at t Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: has material basis
properties.definition: b has material basis c =Def b is a disposition & c is a material entity & there is some d bearer of b & there is some time t such that c is a continuant part of d at t & d has disposition b because c is a continuant part of d at t Users that require more sophisticated representations of time are encouraged to import a temporal extension of BFO-Core provided by the BFO development team. See documentation for guidance: <Link>

properties.label: first instant of
properties.definition: t first instant of t' =Def t is a temporal instant & t' is a temporal region t' & t precedes all temporal parts of t' other than t
examples: An hour starting at midnight yesterday has first instant midnight yesterday

properties.label: has first instant
properties.definition: t has first instant t' =Def t' first instant of t
examples: The first hour of a year has first instant midnight on December 31

properties.label: last instant of
properties.definition: t last instant of t' =Def t is a temporal instant & t' is a temporal region & all temporal parts of t' other than t precede t
examples: Last midnight is the last instant of yesterday

properties.label: has last instant
properties.definition: t has last instant t' =Def t' last instant of t
examples: The last hour of a year has last instant midnight December 31

properties.label: is successor of
properties.definition: x is successor of y =Def y is predecessor of x

properties.label: has process part
properties.definition: x has process part y =Def y is part of process x

properties.label: has object
properties.definition: x has object y =Def y is object of x

properties.label: has inside instant
properties.definition: x has_inside_instant y iff x is an instance of One Dimensional Temporal Region and y is an instance of Temporal Instant and y is_inside_instant_of x.

properties.label: has all members located in
properties.definition: x has all members located in y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of independent continuant but not a spatial region, and every member of x is located in y.

properties.label: agent in
properties.definition: x agent_in y iff y is an instance of Process and x is an instance of Agent, such that x is causally active in y.

properties.label: coincides with
properties.definition: x coincides_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x is a spatial part of y and y is a spatial part of x. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be transitive and symmetric. For more info please refer to

properties.label: has subsidiary
properties.definition: x has subsidiary y =Def y is subsidiary of x

properties.label: has inside interval
properties.definition: x has inside interval y =Def y interval during x

properties.label: tangential part of
properties.definition: x tangential_part_of y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x is a spatial part of y and there exists an instance of Immaterial Entity z such that z externally connects with x and z externally connects with y. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be transitive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: partially overlaps with
properties.definition: x partially overlaps with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x overlaps with y and x is not a spatial part of y and y is not a spatial part of x. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be symmetric. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is supervised by
properties.definition: x is_supervised_by y iff x and y are both instances of Person and y supervises x.

properties.label: role of aggregate
properties.definition: x role_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Role, and x inheres_in_aggregate y.

properties.label: prohibits
properties.definition: x prohibits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must not occur. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be asymmetric and irreflexive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is subject of
properties.definition: x is subject of y =Def y is about x

properties.label: is cause of
properties.definition: x is_cause_of y iff x and y are instances of Process, and y is a consequence of x.

properties.label: is spouse of
properties.definition: Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be symmetric. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is disrupted by
properties.definition: x is disrupted by y =Def y disrupts x

properties.label: is required by
properties.definition: x is required by y =Def y requires x Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be asymmetric and irreflexive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is about
properties.definition: x is_about y is a primitive relationship between an instance of Information Content Entity x and an instance of Entity y.

properties.label: inheres in aggregate
properties.definition: x inheres_in_aggregate y iff x is an instance of Specifically Dependent Continuant or Generically Dependent Continuant and y is an instance of Object Aggregate and y aggregate_bearer_of x.

properties.label: connected with
properties.definition: x is_connected_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and there exists an instance of Immaterial Entity z that is part of both x and y. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be symmetric. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is an ordinal measurement of
properties.definition: x is_an_ordinal_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and y is_measured_by_ordinal x.

properties.label: uses
properties.definition: x uses y iff x is an instance of an Agent and y is an instance of a Material Entity, such that both x and y participate in some instance of a Process wherein x attempts to accomplish a goal by manipulating, deploying, or leveraging some attribute of y.

properties.label: interval finishes
properties.definition: x interval_finishes y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant v, w, and z such that v is the starting instant of x, w is the ending instant of both x and y, z is the starting instant of y, and z is before v.

properties.label: is subsidiary of
properties.definition: x is_subsidiary_of y iff x and y are both instances of Organization and y controls x by having the capacity to determine the outcome of decisions about the financial and operating policies of x.

properties.label: is output of
properties.definition: x is output of y =Def x participates in y, x is an Independent Continuant (but not a Spatial Region), y is a Process, and the presence of x at the end of y is a necessary condition for the completion of y.

properties.label: is prohibited by
properties.definition: x is prohibited by y =Def y prohibits x Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be asymmetric and irreflexive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is in-law of
properties.definition: Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be symmetric. For more info please refer to

properties.label: caused by
properties.definition: x caused by y =Def y is cause of x

properties.label: interval finished by
properties.definition: x interval finished by y =Def y interval finishes x

properties.label: interval equals
properties.definition: x interval_equals y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant w and z such that w is the starting instant of both x and y and z is the ending instant of both x and y.

properties.label: is excerpted from
properties.definition: An Information Bearing Entity b1 is excerpted from another Information Bearing Entity B2 iff b1 is part of some Information Bearing Entity B1 that is carrier of some Information Content Entity C1, B2 is carrier of some Information Content Entity C2, C1 is not identical with C2, b1 is carrier of some Information Content Entity c1, b2 is an Information Bearing Entity that is part of B2 and b2 is carrier of c1 (i.e. the same Information Content Entity as borne by b1).

properties.label: interval overlaps
properties.definition: x interval overlaps y =Def y interval overlapped by x

properties.label: nontangential part of
properties.definition: x nontangential_part_of y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x is a spatial part of y and there does not exist an instance of Immaterial Entity z such that z externally connects with x and z externally connects with y. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be transitive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: disposition of aggregate
properties.definition: x disposition_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Disposition, and x inheres_in_aggregate y.

properties.label: has accomplice
properties.definition: x has accomplice y =Def y accomplice in x

properties.label: is subordinate role to
properties.definition: For all x,y,t: y is subordinate role to x at t iff: x is an instance of Role at time t, and y is an instance of Role at time t, and there is some z such that x is realized by z and z is an instance of Process which creates, modifies, transfers, or eliminates some u such that u is a Process Regulation at time t, and u is addressed to the bearer of y.

properties.label: has some member located in
properties.definition: x has some member located in y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of independent continuant but not a spatial region, and at least one member of x is located in y.

properties.label: has agent
properties.definition: x has agent y =Def y agent in x

properties.label: affects
properties.definition: x affects y =Def y is affected by x

properties.label: aggregate bearer of
properties.definition: x aggregate bearer of y =Def y inheres in aggregate x

properties.label: time zone identifier used by
properties.definition: x time_zone_identifier_used_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Time Zone Identifier, such that x designates the spatial region associated with the time zone mentioned in y.

properties.label: disconnected with
properties.definition: x disconnected_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and there does not exist some immaterial entity z that is part of both x and y. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be symmetric. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is input of
properties.definition: x is input of y =Def x participates in y, x is an Independent Continuant (but not a Spatial Region), y is a Process, and the presence of x at the beginning of y is a necessary condition for the start of y.

properties.label: is paternal first cousin of
properties.definition: Person A is paternal first cousin of Person B iff Person B has father F and F has sibling P and P is parent of Person A. is_paternal_first_cousin_of is not a symmetric relationship as is is_first_cousin_of

properties.label: has sender
properties.definition: x has sender y =Def y sends x

properties.label: is site of
properties.definition: x is site of y =Def y occurs at x

properties.label: is organizational context of
properties.definition: x is_organizational_context_of y iff x is an instance of an Organization and y is an instance of a Role and z is an instance of a Person, such that z's affiliation with x is a prerequisite for z bearing y, or x ascribes y to the bearer of y.

properties.label: interval is after
properties.definition: x interval is after y =Def y interval is before x

properties.label: is inside instant of
properties.definition: x is_inside_instant of y iff x is an instance of Temporal Instant and y is an instance of One-Dimensional Temporal Region and there are instances of Temporal Instant w and z that are part of y and non-identical to x such that w precedes x and z is preceded by x.

properties.label: accessory in
properties.definition: x is_accessory_in y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Process such that x assists another instance of Agent z in the commission of y, and x was not located at the location of y when y occurred, and x is not an agent_in y.

properties.label: has spatial part
properties.definition: x has spatial part y =Def y spatial part of x

properties.label: is part of process
properties.definition: x is part of process y iff x is occurrent part of y, x and y are Processes, and x occupies a temporal region that is a proper occurrent part of the temporal interval of y.

properties.label: is delimited by
properties.definition: x is_delimited_by y iff x is an instance of Organization and y is an instance of Delimiting Domain and y delimits x.

properties.label: interval disjoint
properties.definition: x interval_disjoint y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and have no parts in common.

properties.label: uses measurement unit
properties.definition: x uses measurement unit y =Def y is measurement unit of x

properties.label: delimits
properties.definition: x delimits y =Def y is delimited by x

properties.label: has familial relationship to
properties.definition: A relationship between persons by virtue of ancestry or legal union.

properties.label: is interest of
properties.definition: x is interest of y =Def y has interest in x

properties.label: is a nominal measurement of
properties.definition: x is_a_nominal_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x classifies y relative to some set of shared, possibly arbitrary, characteristics.

properties.label: interval during
properties.definition: x interval_during y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant u, v, w, and z such that u is the starting instant of x, v is the ending instant of x, w is the starting instant of y, z is the ending instant of y, w is before u, and v is before z.

properties.label: interval overlapped by
properties.definition: x is_overlapped_by y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and y interval_overlaps x.

properties.label: represented by
properties.definition: x represented by y =Def y represents x See notes for inverse property.

properties.label: is temporal region of
properties.definition: x is temporal region of y =Def y occupies temporal region x

properties.label: interval started by
properties.definition: x interval started by y =Def y interval starts x

properties.label: is an interval measurement of
properties.definition: x is_an_interval_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Interval Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and y is_measured_by_interval x.
examples: a measurement of air temperature on the Celsius scale.

properties.label: is mention of
properties.definition: x is mention of y =Def y is mentioned by x

properties.label: designated by
properties.definition: x designated by y =Def y designates x

properties.label: capability of aggregate
properties.definition: x capability_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Agent Capability, such that x inheres in aggregate y.

properties.label: condition described by
properties.definition: x condition described by y =Def y describes condition x

properties.label: is affected by
properties.definition: x is affected by y =Def x participates in y, x is an Independent Continuant (but not a Spatial Region), y is a Process, and y influences x in some manner, most often by producing a change in x.

properties.label: disrupts
properties.definition: A relation where one process disrupts another process from occurring as it would have. A process can disrupt another process from occurring as it would have by 1) preventing a disposition or role from being realized by that process, 2) lowering the grade of the process, or 3) stopping the process from continuing to occur.

properties.label: capability of
properties.definition: x capability_of y iff y is an instance of Agent and x is an instance of Agent Capability, such that x inheres in y.

properties.label: instant is after
properties.definition: x instant_is_after y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Instant and there exists some instance of Temporal Interval z such that y is the starting instant of z and x is the ending instant of z. 'instant is after' is a primitive relationship. Informally, a temporal instant x is after some temporal instant y iff y precedes x.

properties.label: accomplice in
properties.definition: Agent x is accomplice_in Process y iff x assists in the commission of y, is located at the location of y, but is not agent_in y.

properties.label: interval meets
properties.definition: x interval meets y =Def y interval met by x

properties.label: aggregate has capability
properties.definition: x aggregate has capability y =Def y capability of aggregate x

properties.label: language used in
properties.definition: x language_used_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Language, such that the literal value of y is a string that is encoded according to the syntax of x.

properties.label: is geospatial coordinate reference system of
properties.definition: x is_geospatial_coordinate_reference_system_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Geospatial Coordinate Reference System, such that x describes the set of standards mentioned in y.

properties.label: aggregate has role
properties.definition: x aggregate_has_role y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of Role, such that x aggregate_bearer_of y.

properties.label: is measured by
properties.definition: x is measured by y =Def y is a measurement of x

properties.label: is maternal first cousin of
properties.definition: Person A is maternal first cousin of Person B iff Person B has mother M and M has sibling P and P is parent of Person A. is_maternal_first_cousin_of is not a symmetric relationship as is is_first_cousin_of

properties.label: aggregate has quality
properties.definition: x aggregate_has_quality y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of Quality, such that x aggregate_bearer_of y.

properties.label: uses time zone identifier
properties.definition: x uses time zone identifier y =Def y time zone identifier used by x

properties.label: has tangential part
properties.definition: x has tangential part y =Def y tangential part of x Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be transitive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: permits
properties.definition: x permits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that y may occur. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be asymmetric and irreflexive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: uses reference system
properties.definition: x uses reference system y =Def y is reference system of x

properties.label: uses geospatial coordinate reference system
properties.definition: x uses geospatial coordinate reference system y =Def y is geospatial coordinate reference system of x

properties.label: is measured by nominal
properties.definition: x is measured by nominal y =Def y is a nominal measurement of x

properties.label: interval met by
properties.definition: x interval_met_by y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and y interval_meets x.

properties.label: designates
properties.definition: x designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be functional. For more info please refer to
examples: a URL designates the location of a Web Page on the internet
a person's name designates that person
a vehicle identification number designates some vehicle

properties.label: described by
properties.definition: x described by y =Def y describes x

properties.label: occurs at
properties.definition: x occurs_at y iff x is an instance of Process and y is an instance of Site, such that x occurs in y.

properties.label: is mentioned by
properties.definition: x is_mentioned_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Entity, such that y is used as a reference to x.

properties.label: prescribed by
properties.definition: x prescribed by y =Def y prescribes x

properties.label: has input
properties.definition: x has input y =Def y is input of x

properties.label: has recipient
properties.definition: x has recipient y =Def y receives x

properties.label: interval starts
properties.definition: x interval_starts y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant v, w, and z such that v is the starting instant of both x and y, w is the ending instant of x, z is the ending instant of y and w is before z.

properties.label: interval contains
properties.definition: x interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x

properties.label: is used by
properties.definition: x is used by y =Def y uses x

properties.label: is predecessor of
properties.definition: x is_predecessor_of y iff x and y are both instances of Independent Continuant and there is some process p and x is an input to p and y is an output of p. More informally, x is_predecessor_of y iff y follows or replaces x.

properties.label: externally connects with
properties.definition: x externally_connects_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x connects with y and x does not overlap y. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be symmetric. For more info please refer to

properties.label: process starts
properties.definition: x process_starts y iff x and y are instances of processes, and x is_cause_of y, and i is an instance of a temporal instant, and r is an instance of a temporal interval, and y has starting instance i, and x occupies temporal region r, and r has inside instant i. A process x starts another process y when x causes y while x is still occurring.

properties.label: is object of
properties.definition: x is object of y =Def x participates in y, x is an Independent Continuant (but not a Spatial Region), y is a Process, and y is performed by Agent z and x is part of the projected state that z intends to achieve by performing y.

properties.label: represents
properties.definition: x represents y iff x is an instance of Representational Information Content Entity, y is an instance of Entity, and z is carrier of x, such that x is about y in virtue of there existing an isomorphism between characteristics of z and y. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be functional. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is affiliated with
properties.definition: x is_affiliated_with y iff x and y are instances of Agent, such that they have any kind of social or business relationship.

properties.label: interval is before
properties.definition: x interval_is_before y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant w, z such that w is the ending instant of x and z is the starting instant of y and w is before z.

properties.label: prescribes
properties.definition: x prescribes y iff x is an instance of Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x serves as a rule or guide for y if y an Occurrent, or x serves as a model for y if y is a Continuant.
examples: A blueprint prescribes some artifact or facility by being a model for it.
A professional code of conduct prescribes some realizations of a profession (role) by giving rules for how the bearer should act in those realizations.
An operations plan prescribes an operation by enumerating the tasks that need to be performed in order to achieve the objectives of the operation.

properties.label: supervises
properties.definition: x supervises y =Def y is supervised by x

properties.label: spatial part of
properties.definition: x spatial_part_of y iff x, y, z, and q are instances of Immaterial Entity, such that for any z connected with x, z is also connected with y, and q is connected with y but not connected with x. in the sense used here, spatial part of is elsewhere referred to as proper spatial part of

properties.label: quality of aggregate
properties.definition: x quality_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Quality, and x inheres_in_aggregate y.

properties.label: has accessory
properties.definition: x has accessory y =Def y accessory in x

properties.label: has subordinate role
properties.definition: x has subordinate role y =Def y is subordinate role to x

properties.label: has capability
properties.definition: x has capability y =Def y capability of x

properties.label: aggregate has disposition
properties.definition: x aggregate has disposition y =Def y disposition of aggregate x

properties.label: inhibits
properties.definition: x inhibits y =Def y is inhibited by x

properties.label: is measurement unit of
properties.definition: x is_measurement_unit_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Measurement Unit, such that x describes the magnitude of measured physical quantity mentioned in y.

properties.label: process started by
properties.definition: x process started by y =Def y process starts x A process x is started by another process y when y causes x while y is still occurring.

properties.label: is measured by ordinal
properties.definition: x is measured by ordinal y =Def y is a ordinal measurement of x

properties.label: is measured by interval
properties.definition: x is measured by interval y =Def y is a interval measurement of x

properties.label: is measured by ratio
properties.definition: x is measured by ratio y =Def y is a ratio measurement of x

properties.label: is a measurement of
properties.definition: x is_a_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x describes some attribute of y relative to some scale or classification scheme. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be functional. For more info please refer to

properties.label: inhibited by
properties.definition: y inhibited_by x iff x and y are non-identical Processes, d is a Decrease of Realizable Entity, and x is_cause_of d, and r is a Realizable Entity, and d has_participant r, and r realized_in y.

properties.label: interval contained by
properties.definition: x interval_contained_by y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and y interval_contains x.

properties.label: requires
properties.definition: x requires y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must occur. Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be asymmetric and irreflexive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: uses language
properties.definition: x uses language y =Def y language used in x

properties.label: has affiliate
properties.definition: x has affiliate y =Def y is affiliated with x

properties.label: receives
properties.definition: x receives y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Act Of Communication, such that x is the recipient and decoder of the InformationContentEntity intended for communication in y.

properties.label: describes condition
properties.definition: p describes_condition c iff p is an instance of a Performance Specification and c is an instance of Entity and p has part d, and d is an instance of a Descriptive Information Content Entity, and p prescribes an entity s, and d describes c, and c is an entity that is causally relevant to s existing as prescribed by p.

properties.label: describes
properties.definition: x describes y iff x is an instance of Descriptive Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of Entity, such that x is_about the characteristics that identify y. It is possible that this relation should be a functional property, that is for all x, y, z if x describes y and x describes z then y = z. For example, if a financial report x describes the quarterly results of a company y and that same financial report describes the quarterly results of a company z, then it should be inferred that companies y and z are the same. We refrained from classifying the relation as a functional property on the concern that descriptions are multifaceted and so consequently it may be that the same report would contain descriptions of multiple entities.
examples: the content of a newspaper article describes some current event
the content of a visitor's log describes some facility visit
the content of an accident report describes some accident

properties.label: is a ratio measurement of
properties.definition: x is_a_ratio_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and x describes some attribute of y relative to a scale having equal unit values and a zero value that corresponds to the absence of the attribute being measured.

properties.label: has interest in
properties.definition: A relation between an Agent and some Process where the Agent has an interest in that Process. There are four conditions in which an agent has an interest in some process. 1) Biological Condition: If a part (including improper part) of an organism has a function, then that organism has an interest in the realization of that function. 2) Artifactual Condition: If a part (including improper part) of an artifact has a function, then some agent or group of agents, at some time, has an interest in the realization of that function. 3) Prescription Condition: If an agent or group of agents has a plan, then it has an interest in the realization of all the processes and process-combinations prescribed by that plan. 4) Facilitation Condition: If (a) agent x has an interest in the realization of a disposition y, and (b) the realization of a disposition z facilitates the realization of disposition y, then (c) x has an interest in the realization of disposition z, and by 'facilitates' we mean that the occurrence of a process w, which realizes realization of z is either (1) required for y, to realize or (2) would contribute positively to the grade of, y's realization.

properties.label: has output
properties.definition: x has output y =Def y is output of x

properties.label: has nontangential part
properties.definition: x has nontangential part y =Def y nontangential part of x Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be transitive. For more info please refer to

properties.label: instant is before
properties.definition: x instant_is_before y iff x and y are both instances of Zero Dimensional Temporal Region and there exists some instance of Temporal Interval z such that x is the starting instant of z and y is the ending instant of z. 'instant is before' is a primitive relationship. Informally, a temporal instant x is before some temporal instant y iff x precedes y.

properties.label: has organizational context
properties.definition: x has organizational context y =Def y is organizational context of x

properties.label: sends
properties.definition: x sends y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Act Of Communication, such that x is the initiator and encoder of the InformationContentEntity intended for communication in y.

properties.label: is parent of
properties.definition: x is_parent_of y is a familial relationship between an instance of Person x and a different instance of Person y.

properties.label: is step-sibling of
properties.definition: Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be symmetric. For more info please refer to

properties.label: is reference system of
properties.definition: x is_reference_system_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Reference System, such that x describes the set of standards mentioned in y.

properties.label: is permitted by
properties.definition: x is permitted by y =Def y permits x Given a stronger temporal interpretation, this property may be asymmetric and irreflexive. For more info please refer to

properties.definition: x process_has_first_instant y Def= x is a Process, y is a Temporal Instant, and there is some Temporal Region z such that y is first_instant_of z, and x occupies_temporal_region z

properties.label: process has last instant
properties.definition: x process_has_last_instant y Def= x is a Process, y is a Temporal Instant, and there is some Temporal Region z such that y is last_instant_of z, and x occupies_temporal_region z.
